title_en: Utah GOP governor on Trump and 2028: ‘It’s time for the next thing’
title_zh: 犹他州共和党州长谈特朗普和 2028 年：“是时候做下一步了”
summary: Gov. Spencer Cox said he’s 'a fan of governors' as he eyes the party’s options for a 2028 nominee.
summary_zh: 州长斯宾塞·考克斯 (Spencer Cox) 在考虑该党 2028 年提名人选时表示，他是“州长的粉丝”。
body_en: Utah’s Republican governor wants his party to move beyond President Donald Trump heading into the next presidential election.

“It’s time for the next thing,” Gov. Spencer Cox said in an interview on Wednesday at the POLITICO Pub, on the sidelines of the National Governors Association’s New Governors Leadership Forum in Deer Valley, Utah.
Cox called on his fellow Republicans to start looking for new leadership in the wake of this month’s midterm election defeats.
“This is how this works when presidents move on. We should be looking for the next leadership in our party and what that looks like,” Cox told POLITICO’s Samuel Benson.

“We’ve got JD Vance and Marco Rubio, and those seem to be kind of the two choices now,” Cox said, referring to the Vice President and Secretary of State, respectively. “But I think you’ll see a lot of people step up … there are a lot of really interesting folks.”
“I’m a fan of governors,” Cox added. “I think governors with executive experience are the best to lead the country.”

Vance told Fox News earlier this week that he would decide “sometime next year” whether he will run for president in 2028. Rubio has dismissed suggestions that he would launch his own bid, and has said he would support Vance if the Vice President ran for the White House.
“I am hopeful that there are some Republican governors that will throw their hat in,” said Cox, a two-term governor. “We can have a competition of ideas heading in to find out what's next.”

Cox said that Trump still has a “really important role to play” in leading the party over the next two years, adding that the president still had an “opportunity” to strike bipartisan deals on permitting reform and other policy areas in his last two years in office.
Cox called the president “unique,” adding: “He’s someone who has the attention of the country in a way that almost no president has had in my lifetime.”
“People really love him or really don’t like him, but everybody’s paying attention to him,” he said.
body_zh: 犹他州共和党州长希望他的政党在下届总统选举中超越唐纳德·特朗普总统。
周三，在犹他州鹿谷举行的全国州长协会新州长领导力论坛间隙，州长斯宾塞·考克斯在 POLITICO 酒吧接受采访时表示，“是时候做下一件事了。”
考克斯呼吁他的共和党同僚在本月中期选举失败后开始寻找新的领导层。
“这就是总统卸任时的运作方式。我们应该寻找党内的下一任领导层，以及他的样子，”考克斯告诉《政治》杂志的塞缪尔·本森。
“我们有 JD 万斯和马可·卢比奥，现在看来这就是两个选择，”考克斯分别指的是副总统和国务卿。 “但我认为你会看到很多人挺身而出……有很多非常有趣的人。”
“我是州长的粉丝，”考克斯补充道。 “我认为具有行政经验的州长是领导国家的最佳人选。”
万斯本周早些时候告诉福克斯新闻，他将在“明年某个时候”决定是否参加 2028 年总统竞选。卢比奥否认了他将自己竞选的建议，并表示如果副总统竞选白宫，他将支持万斯。
“我希望有一些共和党州长能够加入进来，”两届州长考克斯说。 “我们可以进行一场创意竞赛，看看接下来会发生什么。”
考克斯表示，特朗普在未来两年领导该党方面仍将发挥“非常重要的作用”，并补充说，总统在任期的最后两年仍有“机会”就允许改革和其他政策领域达成两党协议。
考克斯称这位总统“独一无二”，并补充道：“他受到了国家的关注，这是我一生中几乎没有一位总统受到关注的。”
“人们真的很爱他，或者真的不喜欢他，但每个人都在关注他，”他说。

title_en: Senate committee rejects Trump nominee to lead National Science Foundation
title_zh: 参议院委员会拒绝特朗普提名领导国家科学基金会
summary: Committee chair Bill Cassidy, a Republican, said Jim O’Neill ‘did not do enough to stand up for science’ in previous posts Jim O’Neill will not undergo a confirmation hearing on Wednesday to head he National Science Foundation (NSF) because he “did not do enou
summary_zh: 委员会主席、共和党人比尔·卡西迪在之前的帖子中表示，吉姆·奥尼尔“在捍卫科学方面做得不够”。
body_en: Committee chair Bill Cassidy, a Republican, said Jim O’Neill ‘did not do enough to stand up for science’ in previous posts

Jim O’Neill will not undergo a confirmation hearing on Wednesday to head he National Science Foundation (NSF) because he “did not do enough to stand up for science” in his previous position, said Bill Cassidy, a Republican from Louisiana who is chair of the Senate committee on health, education, labor and pensions.

This ends O’Neill’s run for the top US scientific organization, an embattled independent federal agency that has seen major budget cuts and grant freezes under the Trump administration . The next NSF nominee will face a Democratic-led Senate.
White House withdraws nomination of Heidi Overton to lead FDA

O’Neill served as acting director of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) from August 2025 to February 2026. In that role, he failed to push back against “irresponsible decisions and statements from Secretary Kennedy”, Cassidy said in opening remarks before the committee on Wednesday, hours before O’Neill was slated to appear.

“His role in the firing of Susan Monarez raised further concerns about the independent judgment he would bring to NSF,” Cassidy added, saying that several members of the committee had concerns about those lapses. Cassidy said that he likes O’Neill personally, “but this time requires leadership and fortitude in standing up for what is right”.

O’Neill also served as deputy secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) from June 2025 to February 2026, a time during which HHS slashed recommendations for routine childhood immunizations.

The White House did not pull O’Neill’s nomination. But Cassidy noted that the White House did yank the nomination of Heidi Overton for commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration, saying she lacked the votes to pass confirmation – which Cassidy said was “pretty odd”.
“I think she would’ve had the votes,” Cassidy said. He noted that anti-abortion senators “sought reassurances from the administration” about Overton’s stances against abortion .
“They chose not to make such commitments and ultimately withdrew Dr Overton,” Cassidy said.
The Republican-led Senate is pushing through confirmation hearings before losing the majority in January.
The NSF’s chief of staff, Brian Stone, is currently performing the duties of NSF director, but in October he announced plans to retire at the end of this year.
body_zh: 委员会主席、共和党人比尔·卡西迪在之前的帖子中表示，吉姆·奥尼尔“在捍卫科学方面做得不够”
来自路易斯安那州的共和党人、参议院健康、教育、劳工和养老金委员会主席比尔·卡西迪表示，吉姆·奥尼尔周三将不会参加国家科学基金会（NSF）主席的确认听证会，因为他在之前的职位上“没有为科学做出足够的努力”。
这结束了奥尼尔对美国顶级科学组织的竞选，这是一个陷入困境的独立联邦机构，在特朗普政府的领导下，该机构经历了重大预算削减和拨款冻结。下一任国家科学基金会提名人将面临民主党领导的参议院。
白宫撤回海蒂·奥弗顿 (Heidi Overton) 领导 FDA 的提名
奥尼尔于 2025 年 8 月至 2026 年 2 月担任美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 代理主任。卡西迪周三在委员会的开场发言中表示，在这一职位上，他未能反驳“肯尼迪部长不负责任的决定和声明”。
卡西迪补充道：“他在解雇苏珊·莫纳雷斯的过程中所扮演的角色进一步引发了人们对他将向国家科学基金会提出的独立判断的担忧。”他表示，委员会的几名成员对这些失误表示担忧。卡西迪表示，他个人喜欢奥尼尔，“但这一次需要领导力和坚持正义的毅力”。
奥尼尔还于 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 2 月期间担任美国卫生与公众服务部 (HHS) 副部长，在此期间，HHS 大幅削减了儿童常规免疫接种的建议。
白宫没有撤回奥尼尔的提名。但卡西迪指出，白宫确实取消了海蒂·奥弗顿(Heidi Overton)担任美国食品和药物管理局局长的提名，称她缺乏通过确认的票数——卡西迪表示这“相当奇怪”。
“我认为她会获得选票，”卡西迪说。他指出，反堕胎参议员就奥弗顿反对堕胎的立场“寻求政府的保证”。
卡西迪说：“他们选择不做出此类承诺，并最终撤回了奥弗顿博士。”
共和党领导的参议院正在推动通过确认听证会，然后在一月份失去多数席位。
NSF的幕僚长布莱恩·斯通(Brian Stone)目前正在履行NSF主任的职责，但他在10月份宣布计划在今年年底退休。

title_en: Trump downplays US outages and Nvidia security concerns in remarks before China summit – live
title_zh: 特朗普在中国峰会前的讲话中淡化了美国的停电和英伟达的安全担忧 - 直播
summary: Asked by Fox News about China’s alleged spying operation, president says: ‘We spy on them too. I think we spy better than they do.’ Sign up for US breaking News email Linked to that, the White House held a briefing call with several reporters today about the w
summary_zh: 当被福克斯新闻问及中国所谓的间谍活动时，总统说：“我们也监视他们。”我认为我们的间谍活动比他们做得更好。”
body_en: Speaking with Fox news, Donald Trump said he wasn’t worried about multiple outages this week affecting Microsoft, US banks, United Airlines computers, the National Security Agency’s internal comms network, Apple services and the national air traffic control system.
“They’re all individual events. These are big companies. They’re putting in new equipment and things happen when you put in new equipment. And these are all individual things,” he said.
When asked whether he raised the issue of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman suspected of being a spy for China with Xi, Trump said he “might’ve referred to it just briefly”
“Because it’s such a tragedy. It’s a tragedy. He’s such a brilliant man ... we have to take care of our geniuses,” Trump said of Huang.

Of Alice Huang, Jensen Huang’s affair partner, the president mused: “I haven’t heard that she was a spy. She was a business woman who bought chips. Who knows if they were bought right or wrong. But I can tell you we allow them to buy. We want to make money.”

However, according to a report by the New York Times, Trump was briefed aboard Air Force One in May en route to China that the US intelligence showed that that Nvidia’s chief executive was in a relationship with a woman thought to be a Chinese spy.
Trump also shrugged off the Fox reporter’s question about whether he would confront China over spying allegations.
“We spy on them too”, he said. “I think we spy better than they do.”
body_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，他并不担心本周影响微软、美国银行、联合航空公司计算机、国家安全局内部通信网络、苹果服务和国家空中交通管制系统的多次停电。
“它们都是个人事件。这些都是大公司。他们正在投入新设备，当你投入新设备时，就会发生一些事情。这些都是个人的事情，”他说。
当被问及他是否向习近平提出了英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌为中国间谍的女性的婚外情问题时，特朗普表示，他“可能只是简单地提到了这一点”
“因为这是一场悲剧。这真是一场悲剧。他是一个如此才华横溢的人……我们必须照顾我们的天才，”特朗普谈到黄。
谈到黄仁勋的外遇伴侣爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)，总统若有所思地说：“我没听说她是间谍。她是一个购买芯片的女商人。谁知道买的是对还是错。但我可以告诉你，我们允许他们购买。我们想赚钱。”
然而，据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普5月在飞往中国的空军一号上获悉，美国情报显示，英伟达首席执行官与一名被认为是中国间谍的女性有关系。
特朗普还对福克斯记者关于他是否会就间谍指控与中国对抗的问题不屑一顾。
“我们也监视他们”，他说。 “我认为我们的间谍活动比他们做得更好。”

title_en: Trump family and allies told to preserve records as Democrats prepare sweeping investigations
title_zh: 民主党准备全面调查之际，特朗普家族和盟友被要求保存记录
summary: Robert Garcia plans searches into Trump family finances, alleged DHS misconduct and handling of Epstein files The incoming Democratic chair of the powerful oversight committee in the House of Representatives has ordered a dozen relatives and allies of Donald T
summary_zh: 罗伯特·加西亚计划调查特朗普家族的财务状况、国土安全部涉嫌不当行为以及爱泼斯坦档案的处理情况
body_en: Robert Garcia plans searches into Trump family finances, alleged DHS misconduct and handling of Epstein files

The incoming Democratic chair of the powerful oversight committee in the House of Representatives has ordered a dozen relatives and allies of Donald Trump to preserve records before investigations he plans to open.

Robert Garcia sent 12 letters on Wednesday to prominent figures in the US president’s orbit, including his sons Donald Jr and Eric; son-in-law Jared Kushner; the vice-president, JD Vance; and the attorney general, Todd Blanche.
“These investigations will lay the groundwork for legislation which helps all Americans,” said Garcia. “This is just the beginning.”

The letters – sent after Democrats decisively won the House in the US midterm elections – are the first detailed map of the investigations Garcia plans to run when he takes control of the oversight committee, and gains subpoena power, in January. They cover the Trump family finances, alleged corporate corruption, alleged misconduct at the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and what Garcia calls a White House cover-up of the Jeffrey Epstein files.
DoJ warns Elizabeth Warren of ‘consequences’ unless she preserves Trump records
“Oversight Democrats are fighting to put an end to this administration’s self-dealing, misconduct and abuse,” Garcia said.

It sets the stage for a legal fight with the White House, which has already threatened prominent Democrats including Garcia over their plans to conduct oversight of the president and his administration.
The Trump administration hit back on Wednesday at Democratic lawmakers who have requested information from administration officials, aides and allies.

In a letter to all ranking committee members in the House and Senate, Will Scharf, the White House general counsel, claimed several of their requests “drip with an animus or pettiness, revealing that the purpose of these letters is not legitimate oversight but to harass and aggrandize”.
The administration is not obligated to respond to requests from members of the minority party – which Democrats remain, until January – Scharf argued. The letter was first obtained by Politico.
A number of the letters were sent to officials whom Garcia holds responsible for how the government has handled the files surrounding Epstein, the late sex offender.

One is Blanche, who became attorney general after Pam Bondi was fired in April, and who has taken responsibility for redaction errors in the documents released under the Epstein Files Transparency Act, the 2025 law that ordered the release of the government’s records. Garcia’s letter cites an outstanding committee subpoena and the Department of Justice’s failure to comply with the law.

Another letter asks federal prison officials why Ghislaine Maxwell, Epstein’s convicted accomplice, was moved from a low-security prison in Florida to a less-restrictive camp in Texas a week after she told Blanche she had never seen Trump behave inappropriately . Garcia’s letters say the move came days after favorable testimony and ask about privileges she has had since.

Garcia also wrote to Vance and to Susie Wiles, the former White House chief of staff, about Situation Room meetings in 2025 on containing the political fallout. “Why are we having meetings in the Situation Room about Epstein strategy?” Garcia asked.

Looking at the Department of Homeland Security under Trump, Garcia wrote to Kristi Noem, the former secretary, and Corey Lewandowski, her former senior adviser, accusing them of using their positions to enrich themselves and their allies.

The justice department is already investigating allegations of contract misconduct at the DHS, including Lewandowski’s role, after a criminal referral from the department’s inspector general. Noem required her personal written approval for contracts, grants and funding obligations above $100,000, and questions about how a $220m advertising contract was awarded helped prompt the inquiry. Lewandowski has not been charged and has denied wrongdoing.
Top Democrat tells Trump and Republicans to ‘lawyer up’ after US midterm defeats

The letters to Donald Trump Jr and Eric Trump center on World Liberty Financial, the crypto venture the family co-founded. The conflict-of-interest questions stem from a Wall Street Journal investigation in 2025 of an Emirati-backed firm taking a 49% stake in the company for $500m shortly before Trump’s inauguration.
body_zh: 罗伯特·加西亚计划调查特朗普家族的财务状况、国土安全部涉嫌不当行为以及爱泼斯坦文件的处理情况
众议院强大监督委员会的即将上任的民主党主席已命令唐纳德·特朗普的十几名亲属和盟友在他计划展开的调查之前保存记录。
罗伯特·加西亚 (Robert Garcia) 周三向美国总统圈内的知名人士发出了 12 封信，其中包括他的儿子小唐纳德 (Donald Jr) 和埃里克 (Eric)；女婿贾里德·库什纳；副总裁 JD Vance；还有司法部长托德·布兰奇。
加西亚说：“这些调查将为帮助所有美国人的立法奠定基础。” “这只是开始。”
这些信件是在民主党在美国中期选举中决定性赢得众议院后发出的，是加西亚计划在 1 月份控制监督委员会并获得传票权时进行的第一份详细调查地图。它们涵盖了特朗普家族的财务状况、涉嫌的公司腐败、涉嫌的国土安全部（DHS）不当行为，以及加西亚所说的白宫掩盖杰弗里·爱泼斯坦文件的情况。
美国司法部警告伊丽莎白·沃伦，除非她保留特朗普的记录，否则将产生“后果”
加西亚说：“监督民主党人正在努力制止本届政府的自我交易、不当行为和滥用职权。”
这为与白宫的法律斗争奠定了基础，白宫已经威胁到包括加西亚在内的民主党知名人士对总统及其政府进行监督的计划。
特朗普政府周三对民主党议员要求政府官员、助手和盟友提供信息的行为进行了反击。
白宫总法律顾问威尔·沙夫在致众议院和参议院所有高级委员会成员的一封信中声称，他们的一些要求“充满敌意或琐碎，表明这些信件的目的不是合法监督，而是为了骚扰和夸大”。
沙夫认为，政府没有义务回应少数党成员的要求——民主党在明年一月之前仍保留少数党。这封信最先由 Politico 获得。
许多信件都寄给了加西亚认为对政府如何处理已故性犯罪者爱泼斯坦的档案负有责任的官员。
其中之一是布兰奇，她在 4 月份帕姆·邦迪被解雇后成为司法部长，她对根据《爱泼斯坦文件透明度法案》发布的文件中的编辑错误承担责任，该法案是 2025 年颁布的一项法律，下令公布政府记录。加西亚的信中提到了委员会未发出的传票以及司法部未能遵守法律的情况。
另一封信询问联邦监狱官员，为什么爱泼斯坦的同谋吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦(Ghislaine Maxwell)从佛罗里达州的一所安全级别低的监狱转移到德克萨斯州一个限制较少的营地，一周前她告诉布兰奇，她从未见过特朗普的不当行为。加西亚的信中说，这一举动是在有利的证词几天后做出的，并询问了她此后所享有的特权。
加西亚还写信给万斯和前白宫办公厅主任苏西·威尔斯，讨论 2025 年召开的战情室会议，讨论遏制政治影响。 “我们为什么要在战情室开会讨论爱泼斯坦的策略？”加西亚问道。
看看特朗普领导下的国土安全部，加西亚写信给前国务卿克里斯蒂·诺姆和她的前高级顾问科里·莱万多夫斯基，指责他们利用职务为自己和盟友谋取利益。

title_en: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
title_zh: 随着服药过量死亡人数下降，白宫对谁值得赞扬做出了误导性的说法
summary: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.
summary_zh: 白宫在一份庆祝毒品死亡历史性下降的声明中指出，自特朗普总统上任以来取得了一些成功。事实上，大
body_en: White House fails to credit Biden role in U.S. drug deaths drop : NPR

White House fails to credit Biden role in U.S. drug deaths drop In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

Families look on as President Donald Trump speaks during a ceremony to sign the "Halt All Lethal Trafficking of Fentanyl Act" in the East Room of the White House on July 16, 2025. Evan Vucci/AP hide caption

When the White House announced big improvements in the number of people dying from fatal drug overdoses earlier this week, officials pointed to hopeful new data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention showing U.S. drug deaths have plunged to their lowest level in roughly a decade, saving nearly 50,000 lives each year.
NPR Exclusive: U.S. overdose deaths plummet, saving thousands of lives

But leading drug policy researchers say the White House statement also made misleading claims about the timing and cause of the remarkable public health success when it said that gains occurred primarily over the last 18 months due to policies enacted under President Trump's leadership.

"The historic decline in drug overdose deaths demonstrates that America is unequivocally winning the fight against illicit drugs," White House Office of National Drug Control Policy director Sara Carter said in a statement .

Carter credited heightened border security under Trump and claims of success dismantling "narco-terrorist" organizations for the recovery. "Critically, this represents a an approximately 41.5% decrease in total drug overdose deaths compared to the peak under the previous administration," the statement said.
What the White House failed to disclose is that declines in overdose fatalities began much earlier, under the Biden administration, with most of the gains occurring before Trump returned to office.

"Since the spring of 2023, we have seen a steady decline in overdose deaths," said Vanda Felbab-Brown, a drug policy expert at the Brookings Institution. "The fact that it has been sustained is very important."
Fentanyl crisis on Biden's watch, then a pivot toward fewer deaths

According to CDC data, reductions in drug deaths began in 2023 and have continued steadily for at least 39 consecutive months — not 18 months as the ONDCP statement said. By the time Biden left office, fatal overdoses had already dropped by roughly one-third, an improvement described by addiction experts at the time as unprecedented.
Hospital staff said he was faking it and released him. He died from an overdose soon after

Nabarun Dasgupta, a street drug researcher at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, was one of the first scientists to detect the stunning drop in overdose deaths. He said the trend toward fewer deaths began in some regions and among some demographic groups as early as 2021 and rapidly gained momentum nationwide.
"It was really the period early 2024 through spring 2025 where we were seeing the greatest rate of decline that we've ever seen," Dasgupta said.

Deaths from fentanyl smuggled into the U.S. from Mexico first began to rise in 2013 during President Obama's time in office and accelerated during Trump's first term. Fentanyl overdoses spiked sharply the first two years of Biden's presidency, during the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite progress, fentanyl remains the leading cause of drug deaths nationwide.

Dasgupta, Felbab-Brown and other and addiction experts credit the Biden administration for rolling out policy responses that included wider access to healthcare, making the opioid overdose medication naloxone more readily available, and negotiating a deal with China that disrupted the flow of industrial chemicals used to make fentanyl.

President Joe Biden met China's President President Xi Jinping in Woodside, Calif., in November 2023, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperative conference. China agreed to curtail shipments of the chemicals used to make fentanyl, the drug at the heart of the U.S. overdose epidemic. Doug Mills/Pool/The New York Times hide caption
body_zh: 白宫未能承认拜登在美国毒品死亡人数下降中的作用：NPR
白宫未能将美国毒品死亡人数下降归功于拜登在一份庆祝毒品死亡人数历史性下降的声明中，白宫指出了特朗普总统上任以来取得的成功。事实上，最大的进展发生在拜登政府时期。
2025 年 7 月 16 日，家人在白宫东厅观看唐纳德·特朗普总统在签署《制止所有致命芬太尼法案》的仪式上发表讲话。Evan Vucci/美联社 隐藏标题栏
当白宫本周早些时候宣布因致命药物过量死亡的人数大幅改善时，官员们指出，疾病控制和预防中心的新数据充满希望，显示美国药物死亡人数已降至大约十年来的最低水平，每年挽救近 5 万人的生命。
NPR 独家报道：美国吸毒过量死亡人数大幅下降，挽救了数千人的生命
但主要的药物政策研究人员表示，白宫的声明还对公共卫生领域取得显著成功的时间和原因做出了误导性的说法，称公共卫生方面的进展主要是在过去 18 个月内由于特朗普总统领导下制定的政策而取得的。
白宫国家药物管制政策办公室主任萨拉·卡特在一份声明中表示：“药物过量死亡人数的历史性下降表明，美国正在毫无疑问地赢得打击非法药物的斗争。”
卡特将经济复苏归功于特朗普领导下加强的边境安全以及成功瓦解“毒品恐怖分子”组织的说法。声明称：“至关重要的是，与上届政府时期的峰值相比，这意味着药物过量死亡总数减少了约 41.5%。”
白宫没有透露的是，在拜登政府领导下，服药过量死亡人数的下降开始得更早，其中大部分进展发生在特朗普重返办公室之前。
布鲁金斯学会毒品政策专家万达·费尔巴布-布朗 (Vanda Felbab-Brown) 表示：“自 2023 年春季以来，我们看到服药过量死亡人数稳步下降。” “它一直持续下去这一事实非常重要。”
拜登领导下的芬太尼危机，随后转向减少死亡人数
根据 CDC 数据，毒品死亡人数从 2023 年开始下降，并至少连续 39 个月稳定持续——而不是 ONDCP 声明中所说的 18 个月。到拜登卸任时，致命的吸毒过量事件已经减少了大约三分之一，当时的成瘾专家称这一改善是前所未有的。
医院工作人员称他是假装，并释放了他。不久后他就因服药过量而死亡
北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的街头毒品研究员纳巴伦·达斯古普塔 (Nabarun Dasgupta) 是最早发现吸毒过量死亡人数大幅下降的科学家之一。他表示，早在 2021 年，一些地区和一些人口群体就开始出现死亡人数减少的趋势，并在全国范围内迅速蔓延。
达斯古普塔说：“实际上，从 2024 年初到 2025 年春季，我们看到了有史以来最大的下降速度。”
从墨西哥走私到美国的芬太尼造成的死亡人数在 2013 年奥巴马总统执政期间首次开始上升，并在特朗普第一个任期内加速。拜登就任总统的头两年，即 COVID-19 大流行期间，芬太尼过量服用急剧增加。尽管取得了进展，芬太尼仍然是全国范围内毒品死亡的主要原因。
达斯古普塔、费尔巴布-布朗和其他成瘾专家赞扬拜登政府推出的政策应对措施，包括更广泛地获得医疗保健、使阿片类药物过量药物纳洛酮更容易获得，以及与中国谈判达成一项协议，扰乱用于制造芬太尼的工业化学品的流动。
2023 年 11 月，乔·拜登总统在亚太经济合作组织会议期间在加利福尼亚州伍德赛德会见了中国国家主席习近平。中国同意减少用于制造芬太尼的化学品的运输，芬太尼是美国药物过量流行的核心药物。道格米尔斯/普尔/纽约时报隐藏标题栏

title_en: US senators urge White House AI chief to fix vulnerabilities after mass outages
title_zh: 美国参议员敦促白宫人工智能负责人修复大规模中断后的漏洞
summary: As Democrats flag AI bank breaches and cyber-attacks in Japan, Jay Clayton says system failures happen US politics live – latest updates A bipartisan pair of US senators are calling on Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence and AI czar, to identify
summary_zh: 当民主党人指出日本人工智能银行违规和网络攻击时，杰伊·克莱顿 (Jay Clayton) 表示，美国政治现场发生系统故障——最新动态
body_en: US senators urge White House AI chief to fix vulnerabilities after mass outages | US politics
As Democrats flag AI bank breaches and cyber-attacks in Japan, Jay Clayton says system failures happen

A bipartisan pair of US senators are calling on Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence and AI czar, to identify and fix vulnerabilities in the US’s infrastructure following nationwide outages at major companies and government agencies.

Maria Cantwell, the top Democrat on the Senate commerce, science, and transportation committee, and Mike Rounds, the Republican chair of the Senate subcommittee on cybersecurity, sent a letter to Clayton on Tuesday, outlining concerns sparked by reports of AI accessing major banks, cyber-attacks in Japan and more.

“The fundamental problem is that AI can discover software weaknesses and help attackers exploit them faster than many organizations can respond,” Cantwell and Rounds wrote to Clayton, who is also serving as the White House AI czar.
“Even when fixes are available, testing and installing patches across interconnected systems can take weeks or months, potentially disrupting essential services,” the senators wrote.

Over the last week, tech outages at major banks, workplace communication systems and even federal infrastructure like the Federal Aviation Administration – triggering a four-hour nationwide flight stoppage that grounded or delayed thousands of flights – have raised alarms about potential cyber-attacks.
Top officials have insisted the disruptions stem from software patch updates that intend to address potential AI harms.
Clayton and other national security officials told lawmakers on Wednesday that there was no indication the recent outages were the result of a malicious attack.

“Based on what we know today, after a great deal of diligence, these are separate service outages associated with maintenance and technical changes. They are not a coordinated or state-sponsored attack,” Clayton said during the House homeland security committee hearing.
Markwayne Mullin, the homeland security secretary, and Christopher Raia, the deputy FBI director, similarly said they had no reason to believe the outages were connected or the result of an attack.

“Many people are patching their systems. They know that they’re legacy systems, have vulnerabilities, they’re outdated,” Clayton told CNBC on Tuesday . “It is time for an upgrade across our digital infrastructure and as you patch and upgrade your systems, taking them down and bringing them back up, there are things like this that happen.”

Mark Warner, the top Democrat on the Senate intelligence committee, echoed Clayton . “AI is making it possible to identify vulnerabilities across enormous numbers of systems at unprecedented speed, creating enormous pressure on companies and government agencies to patch those vulnerabilities immediately, often all at once, putting tremendous strain on systems that weren’t built to handle that pace of change,” he wrote on X.
Marco Rubio, the secretary of state, attempted to quell public speculation and fear by assuring Americans that the tech outages were not linked to one another or the work of malicious actors.

But nationwide cyber outages have roiled the country, filled with voters who are already skeptical of rapidly integrating and developing AI . It is unclear what exactly has caused the widespread outages or if AI played a role.
JD Vance canceled his scheduled interview at the New York Times’ DealBook summit on Wednesday, citing his need to attend meetings addressing the recent tech outages.

Cantwell and Rounds are asking Clayton to provide cybersecurity tools to critical US infrastructure such as hospitals, utilities, small government, federal agencies and more, to prevent further disruptions.

They are also asking that US cybersecurity teams secure the same AI systems that are deployed to find vulnerabilities in software, raising concerns that they can “gain unauthorized access to sensitive systems”.
body_zh: 美国参议员敦促白宫人工智能负责人修复大规模中断后的漏洞美国政治
当民主党人指出日本人工智能银行违规和网络攻击时，杰伊·克莱顿表示系统故障时有发生
美国两党参议员呼吁国家情报总监兼人工智能沙皇杰伊·克莱顿（Jay Clayton）在全国范围内的大公司和政府机构停电后，识别并修复美国基础设施中的漏洞。
参议院商业、科学和交通委员会民主党领袖玛丽亚·坎特韦尔(Maria Cantwell)和参议院网络安全小组委员会共和党主席迈克·朗兹(Mike Rounds)周二致信克莱顿，概述了人工智能访问主要银行、日本网络攻击等报道引发的担忧。
坎特韦尔和朗兹在给同时担任白宫人工智能沙皇的克莱顿的信中写道：“根本问题是，人工智能可以发现软件弱点，并帮助攻击者利用它们，速度比许多组织的响应速度都要快。”
参议员们写道：“即使有可用的修复程序，在互连系统上测试和安装补丁也可能需要数周或数月的时间，这可能会扰乱基本服务。”
上周，主要银行、工作场所通信系统甚至联邦航空管理局等联邦基础设施的技术中断，引发了全国范围内长达四个小时的航班停飞，导致数千架航班停飞或延误，引发了人们对潜在网络攻击的警报。
高级官员坚称，这些中断源于旨在解决潜在人工智能危害的软件补丁更新。
克莱顿和其他国家安全官员周三告诉立法者，没有迹象表明最近的停电是恶意攻击造成的。
克莱顿在众议院国土安全委员会听证会上表示：“根据我们今天所知，经过大量调查，这些都是与维护和技术变更相关的单独服务中断。它们不是协调或国家支持的攻击。”
国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林和联邦调查局副局长克里斯托弗·拉亚也同样表示，他们没有理由相信这些停电是相互关联的或由攻击造成的。
“许多人正在修补他们的系统。他们知道自己是遗留系统，存在漏洞，而且已经过时了，”克莱顿周二告诉 CNBC。 “现在是对我们的数字基础设施进行升级的时候了，当你修补和升级你的系统，将它们关闭并重新启动时，就会发生类似的事情。”
参议院情报委员会民主党领袖马克·华纳 (Mark Warner) 赞同克莱顿的观点。他在 X 上写道：“人工智能使得以前所未有的速度识别大量系统中的漏洞成为可能，这给公司和政府机构带来了巨大的压力，要求他们立即（通常是一次性）修补这些漏洞，这给那些无法应对这种变化速度的系统带来了巨大的压力。”
美国国务卿马可·卢比奥 (Marco Rubio) 试图通过向美国人保证这些技术中断与彼此或恶意行为者无关，来平息公众的猜测和恐惧。
但全国范围内的网络中断已经扰乱了整个国家，选民们已经对人工智能的快速整合和发展持怀疑态度。目前尚不清楚到底是什么导致了大范围的停电，也不清楚人工智能是否发挥了作用。
JD Vance 取消了原定于周三在纽约时报 DealBook 峰会上接受的采访，理由是他需要参加解决最近技术中断问题的会议。
坎特韦尔和朗兹要求克莱顿为医院、公用事业、小型政府、联邦机构等美国关键基础设施提供网络安全工具，以防止进一步的干扰。
他们还要求美国网络安全团队保护用于查找软件漏洞的相同人工智能系统，这引发了人们对他们可能“未经授权访问敏感系统”的担忧。

title_en: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
title_zh: 众议院民主党人警告特朗普的 13 名盟友保存他们的记录以供即将进行的调查
summary: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.
summary_zh: 即将上任的众议院监督委员会主席罗伯特·加西亚 (Robert Garcia) 信件的收件人包括小唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump Jr.) 和埃里克·特朗普 (Eric Trump)、贾里德·库什尼 (Jared Kushne)
body_en: Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., appears at a news conference outside the U.S. Capitol on Dec. 13, 2023. On Wednesday, he released document preservation letters that lay the groundwork for incoming investigations into the Trump family and its allies. Drew Angerer/Getty Images hide caption

The highest-ranking Democrat on the House Oversight Committee sent document preservation letters to over a dozen of President Trump's allies and family members, laying the groundwork for incoming investigations come January.

"Oversight Democrats are fighting to put an end to this Administration's self-dealing, misconduct, and abuse," said Rep. Robert Garcia, who is poised to become the chair of the committee. "These investigations will lay the groundwork for legislation which helps all Americans. This is just the beginning."
The California Democrat's targets fall into four broad categories: "Trump family corruption, corporate corruption, DHS misconduct, and the White House Epstein cover-up."
"Americans should be secure in the knowledge that their government is focused on their best interests—not on making the President's family richer," many of the letters read.

The Trump administration has previously rejected accusations of misconduct and has warned Garcia that overly zealous investigations could constitute a crime — a claim legal experts have broadly pushed back against, citing Congress' oversight authorities.

In a letter dated Nov. 9, White House Counsel Will Scharf told Garcia the administration was "monitoring" the speech of Democrats in Congress as they mapped out investigative targets into the Trump administration. The letter warned that efforts by Democrats to investigate the administration "may cross the line into blatant criminality."

"As the President has said, he's willing to work with anyone to continue delivering victories for hardworking Americans," White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis said in a statement on Wednesday in response to Garcia's letters. "If Democrats choose to pursue sham investigations and radical left policies, they are choosing to work against the American people."
Here's a closer look at the letters Garcia sent

Donald Trump Jr. — "pay to play" allegations and potential conflicts of interest, his stake in World Liberty Financial, and the financing of his wedding after-party by a Russian businessman with ties to the Kremlin. President Trump later told reporters the costs for the wedding celebration was later paid back. "You have engaged in business pursuits that appear to have allowed you to personally profit from your father's presidency on a massive scale and at the expense of the American people," the letter reads.

Eric Trump — "pay to play" allegations and potential conflicts of interest, his stake in World Liberty Financial, the Trump family's cryptocurrency venture. "Oversight Democrats have found that your roles as a co-founder of World Liberty Financial and a key player in the Trump family's pay-to-play schemes have raked in billions of dollars for the Trump family over the past several years," said the letter.

Jared Kushner , Trump's son-in-law — allegations of conflicts of interest, his investment firm Affinity Partners, and using his government role to enrich himself and his companies. "Directly or indirectly, you have received billions of dollars in fees and investments with particularly troubling ties to Middle East states where you also have a government role," the letter reads. "This raises urgent questions about transparency, conflicts of interest, and the abuse of what appears to clearly be a government position—with influence over war, peace, and nuclear proliferation as well as direct access to President Trump—for personal profit."

Former Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle . She was previously engaged to Trump Jr., and was contacted by Garcia over allegations of pay-to-play schemes. "As ambassador, you appear to have been intent on leveraging your position to cash-in," said the letter.
Trust for the National Mall CEO Catherine Townsend — construction and donations for the White House ballroom, financed in part via private donations to the Trust.

White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller — allegations of abuses by Immigration and Customs Enforcement under his direction. "Members of the Trump Administration have described you as the 'linchpin' and 'architect' of the Trump Administration's most extreme policies, advocating for the widespread abuse of civil liberties," reads the letter. "We have documented, and will continue to document, your role in orchestrating, overseeing, and defending these abuses."
Former Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and former DHS senior advisor Corey Lewandowski — allegations of abuse of DHS funds, corruption and self-dealing.

Vice President J.D. Vance — allegations of secret meetings inside the White House Situation Room about the administration's handling of the Epstein files. "Reportedly, you were even the first to suggest that Ghislaine Maxwell be interviewed in hopes of using her testimony to distance President Trump from Epstein, despite President Trump's well-documented decades-long friendship with the notorious abuser and sex-trafficker," the letter reads. "These discussions appear to be directly linked to an apparent quid pro quo in which Maxwell was moved to a minimum-security prison camp after she made favorable statements about President Trump in a highly unusual prison interview conducted by then-Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche."

Former White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles — allegations of secret White House meetings surrounding the Epstein investigation. "Reporting describes you as refusing to release documents concerning allegations against President Trump to the public," the letter said.

Attorney General Todd Blanche — allegations of a cover-up of the Epstein files, failure to comply with the Epstein Files Transparency Act, and the decision to transfer Maxwell to a minimum-security prison. "You have refused to cooperate with our investigation, or to fulfill your legal responsibilities to be transparent with the Committee and the American people," the letter said. "This obstruction is even more concerning given your direct involvement in the broader cover-up, as well as your history as President Trump's personal attorney."
body_zh: 加利福尼亚州民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚 (Robert Garcia) 于 2023 年 12 月 13 日出现在美国国会大厦外的新闻发布会上。周三，他发布了文件保存信件，为接下来对特朗普家族及其盟友的调查奠定了基础。德鲁·安格勒/盖蒂图片社隐藏标题栏
众议院监督委员会中级别最高的民主党人向特朗普总统的十多名盟友和家人发出了文件保存信，为一月份的调查奠定了基础。
“监督民主党人正在努力制止本届政府的自我交易、不当行为和滥用职权，”即将成为该委员会主席的众议员罗伯特·加西亚说。 “这些调查将为帮助所有美国人的立法奠定基础。这只是一个开始。”
这位加州民主党人的目标分为四大类：“特朗普家族腐败、企业腐败、国土安全部不当行为以及白宫爱泼斯坦的掩盖行为。”
许多信中写道：“美国人应该放心，他们的政府关注的是他们的最大利益，而不是让总统的家人变得更富有。”
特朗普政府此前拒绝了不当行为的指控，并警告加西亚，过度热心的调查可能构成犯罪——法律专家以国会监督机构为由普遍反驳了这一说法。
在 11 月 9 日的一封信中，白宫法律顾问威尔·沙夫 (Will Scharf) 告诉加西亚，政府正在“监视”国会民主党人的言论，因为他们制定了针对特朗普政府的调查目标。这封信警告说，民主党调查政府的努力“可能会跨越界限，成为公然的犯罪行为”。
“正如总统所说，他愿意与任何人合作，继续为勤劳的美国人带来胜利，”白宫发言人劳伦·比斯周三在一份声明中回应加西亚的信函时表示。 “如果民主党选择进行虚假调查和激进的左翼政策，他们就是在选择与美国人民作对。”
这是加西亚寄出的信件的详细查看
小唐纳德·特朗普——“付费玩”指控和潜在的利益冲突、他在世界自由金融公司的股份，以及一位与克里姆林宫有联系的俄罗斯商人为他的婚礼后的派对提供资金。特朗普总统后来告诉记者，婚礼庆典的费用后来得到了偿还。信中写道：“你从事的商业活动似乎让你个人从你父亲的总统任期中大规模获利，而牺牲了美国人民的利益。”
埃里克·特朗普（Eric Trump）——“付费玩”指控和潜在的利益冲突，他在特朗普家族的加密货币企业世界自由金融公司（World Liberty Financial）中的股份。信中说：“监督民主党人发现，你作为世界自由金融公司的联合创始人和特朗普家族付费游戏计划的关键参与者，在过去几年里为特朗普家族赚取了数十亿美元。”

特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）——被指控存在利益冲突、他的投资公司 Affinity Partners，以及利用他的政府角色为自己和他的公司谋取利益。信中写道：“你们直接或间接地收到了数十亿美元的费用和投资，与你们还担任政府职务的中东国家的关系尤其令人不安。” “这引发了关于透明度、利益冲突以及滥用政府立场（对战争、和平和核扩散具有影响力以及直接接触特朗普总统）以谋取个人利益等紧迫问题。”
前驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔。她之前曾与小特朗普订婚，加西亚曾就付费游戏指控与她联系。信中说：“作为大使，你似乎一心想利用你的职位来赚钱。”
国家广场信托基金首席执行官凯瑟琳·汤森德 - 白宫宴会厅的建设和捐款，部分资金来自信托基金的私人捐款。
白宫办公厅主任斯蒂芬·米勒——指控移民和海关执法局在他的领导下滥用职权。信中写道：“特朗普政府成员将你描述为特朗普政府最极端政策的‘关键’和‘设计师’，主张广泛侵犯公民自由。” “我们已经并将继续记录你在策划、监督和捍卫这些虐待行为中所扮演的角色。”
前国土安全部部长克里斯蒂·诺姆和前国土安全部高级顾问科里·莱万多夫斯基——指控滥用国土安全部资金、腐败和自我交易。

副总统 J.D. 万斯——指控在白宫战情室内举行秘密会议，讨论政府对爱泼斯坦档案的处理情况。信中写道：“据报道，你甚至是第一个建议采访吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔的人，希望利用她的证词来拉开特朗普总统与爱泼斯坦的距离，尽管特朗普总统与臭名昭著的虐待者和性贩运者有着长达数十年的友谊。” “这些讨论似乎与明显的交换条件直接相关，麦克斯韦在时任副司法部长托德·布兰奇进行的一次极不寻常的监狱采访中发表了对特朗普总统有利的言论后，被转移到最低安全级别的监狱营地。”
前白宫办公厅主任苏西·威尔斯——指控白宫围绕爱泼斯坦调查举行秘密会议。信中称：“报道称，你们拒绝向公众公布有关针对特朗普总统的指控的文件。”
司法部长托德·布兰奇——指控掩盖爱泼斯坦档案、未遵守爱泼斯坦档案透明度法案以及决定将麦克斯韦尔转移到最低安全级别的监狱。信中说：“你们拒绝配合我们的调查，也拒绝履行对委员会和美国人民保持透明的法律责任。” “考虑到你直接参与了更广泛的掩盖行动，以及你作为特朗普总统私人律师的历史，这种阻碍更加令人担忧。”

title_en: Xi speaks at APEC summit ahead of rare meeting with Trump and Putin
title_zh: 习近平在与特朗普和普京举行罕见会晤之前在亚太经合组织峰会上发表讲话
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and President Trump are expected to speak at a summit in China, ahead of a face-to-face meeting between Mr. Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
summary_zh: 中国国家主席习近平和特朗普总统预计将在中国举行的峰会上发表讲话，之后特朗普、习近平和特朗普总统将举行面对面的会晤。
body_en: President Trump and his Chinese and Russian counterparts are in China for a summit and a set of rare face-to-face talks between the leaders of three of the world's most powerful countries.

Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed members of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, and called on member countries to "look out for each other" and "expand our shared interests," including on trade and economic growth. Mr. Trump could speak later on in the session.
Mr. Trump and Xi are then scheduled to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

The U.S. president has said he's planning to discuss denuclearization with the leaders of China and Russia — which, along with the United States, make up the world's three largest holders of nuclear weapons. But a range of other global challenges and points of tension are lingering in the background.

The summit is taking place in the capital of the Chinese tech industry, a sector that has drawn intense scrutiny in recent weeks amid worries that advanced U.S. computer chips are surreptitiously reaching China. The scandal was sparked by allegations that now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a businesswoman and suspected Chinese intelligence asset, Alice Huang , whose company is accused of diverting Nvidia's coveted AI chips to China. Beijing has dismissed claims that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy as "groundless speculation" and "nothing more than an attempt to smear China."

Mr. Trump — an ally of Jensen Huang's — told reporters he may bring up the businesswoman during his meetings in China, though he said, "I don't know that she is a spy." Her firm, Megaspeed , is under Justice Department investigation. It has denied wrongdoing.

Shortly after the concerns about Jensen Huang surfaced, the Trump administration issued a new rule aimed at curbing China and other countries' ability to remotely access advanced AI chips. China and the U.S. have also discussed broader AI policy issues in recent months, including setting up a communication channel to share information when AI systems go haywire.
Mr. Trump has said he also expects to talk about Iran. China has historically been among the largest customers of Iranian oil, and Russia has maintained ties with Iran.

The White House previously said the war in Ukraine would not be a topic of discussion since no Ukrainian representatives will be present. But on Monday, Mr. Trump said he expects the issue to come up, calling it "my favorite subject."

Asked if he plans to bring up Taiwan with Xi, Mr. Trump said, "I'm sure he'll raise it." During the U.S. president's last visit to China in the spring, Xi reportedly delivered a stern warning about the island , which he has long vowed to reintegrate with mainland China, floating potential "clashes and even conflicts" if the issue isn't "handled properly."
Chinese and American envoys may also discuss trade, as a truce in the two countries' tit-for-tat 2025 tariff war is set to expire on Jan. 10 of next year.
And Mr. Trump is expected to press Xi to release two detained Americans, CBS News has reported . China has resisted repeated U.S. calls for their release.

body_zh: 特朗普总统与中国和俄罗斯总统正在中国举行峰会，并在世界上最强大的三个国家的领导人之间进行一系列罕见的面对面会谈。
中国国家主席习近平在深圳向亚太经合组织成员国发表讲话，呼吁成员国“相互照顾”并“扩大共同利益”，包括在贸易和经济增长方面。特朗普先生可能会在会议晚些时候发表讲话。
特朗普和习近平随后计划会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。
美国总统表示，他计划与中国和俄罗斯领导人讨论无核化问题，这两个国家与美国一起构成世界三大核武器持有国。但一系列其他全球挑战和紧张局势依然挥之不去。
此次峰会在中国科技行业之都举行，由于担心先进的美国计算机芯片正在秘密进入中国，该行业近几周受到严格审查。该丑闻的起因是，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋与一名女商人、涉嫌中国情报资产的黄爱丽丝有染，黄爱丽的公司被指控将英伟达令人垂涎的人工智能芯片转移到中国。北京否认黄爱丽是中国间谍的说法，称其为“毫无根据的猜测”，“只不过是企图抹黑中国”。
黄仁勋的盟友特朗普告诉记者，他可能会在中国开会时提到这位女商人，不过他说，“我不知道她是间谍。”她的公司 Megaspeed 正在接受司法部调查。它否认有不当行为。
在对黄仁勋的担忧浮出水面后不久，特朗普政府发布了一项新规则，旨在遏制中国和其他国家远程访问先进人工智能芯片的能力。近几个月来，中国和美国还讨论了更广泛的人工智能政策问题，包括建立沟通渠道，以便在人工智能系统失控时共享信息。
特朗普表示，他还希望谈论伊朗问题。中国历来是伊朗石油的最大客户之一，俄罗斯也与伊朗保持着联系。
白宫此前表示，乌克兰战争不会成为讨论的话题，因为没有乌克兰代表出席。但周一，特朗​​普表示，他预计这个问题会出现，并称其为“我最喜欢的话题”。
当被问及是否计划与习近平讨论台湾问题时，特朗普说：“我确信他会提出这个问题。”据报道，在美国总统今年春天最后一次访问中国期间，习近平对台湾发出了严厉警告，他长期以来一直发誓要让台湾与中国大陆重新融合，如果问题得不到“妥善处理”，可能会发生“冲突甚至冲突”。
中国和美国特使也可能讨论贸易问题，因为两国针锋相对的2025年关税战休战协议将于明年1月10日到期。
据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，特朗普预计将敦促习近平释放两名被拘留的美国人。中国拒绝了美国一再要求释放他们的要求。

title_en: Elon Musk says he is ‘not MAGA’ after spending millions on Trump and his allies
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克在特朗普及其盟友身上花费了数百万美元后表示，他“不是 MAGA”
summary: Elon Musk struck a more moderate tone while discussing his political affiliation Wednesday, arguing that he does not have “blind adherence” to the policies of the Republican Party or MAGA.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克周三在讨论他的政治立场时语气更加温和，称他没有“盲目遵守”政治立场
body_en: Elon Musk says he feels 'foolish' after spending hundreds of millions backing Republicans
Elon Musk struck a more moderate tone while discussing his political affiliation Wednesday, arguing that he does not have “blind adherence” to the policies of the Republican Party or MAGA.

The tech billionaire, who spent nearly $500 million in contributions to Republican campaigns and Trump allies ahead of the midterm elections, made the remarks while he was in China as part of President Donald Trump’s delegation at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

“I’m not MAGA,” Musk said during an interview for the New York Times DealBook Summit. “If that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don’t have that.”

Musk, who moved his companies to Texas in 2020 after clashing with Democratic leaders in California, spent at least $168 million in Texas to uplift Trump allies in the midterm elections, including Senate candidate Ken Paxton and Gov. Greg Abbott, who both lost their bids.
In the interview, Musk said that he thinks Democratic Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa will be “quite moderate” when she takes office.
“I don’t think she’s sort of a far-left governor, and based on everything I’ve heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor,” Musk said.

He argued that he spent big on campaigns because he thinks “it’s good to have some balance of power,” adding, “as a general rule” he wouldn’t want “the presidency, Senate and House all to be of the same party.”
Musk said his goal, “which failed, by the way, obviously,” was to hold a Republican majority with 51 seats by 2029.
“I feel pretty foolish about having spent so much money and not seeing much for it,” Musk said. “But it certainly shows that, you know, American elections are not just about money.”
He added, “Probably, if I could rewind the clock, I would have spent less money.”
“I think there are positives and negatives in both parties,” Musk said. “The truth is that, you know, both parties have their issues.”
This is not the first time that Musk’s generous campaign donations have backfired.

In 2025, he funneled at least $20 million into Wisconsin’s state Supreme Court race and offered $1 million checks to voters for backing the conservative candidate, who ultimately lost by 10 percentage points.

After that campaign’s failures, Musk largely stayed out of the spotlight during the 2026 cycle. Some Republicans said privately that they wanted Musk to keep his distance, pointing to the success of his 2024 campaign strategy.
Then, Musk spent over $250 million on Trump and the party, helping fuel Republicans’ victory in the race for the White House and control of Congress.
The technique didn’t work in 2026, especially in Musk’s home state of Texas, where he has already been targeted by incoming officials.

State Sen. Nathan Johnson, who will be the next state attorney general, pledged to investigate Musk over allegations that SpaceX unfairly benefited from a state grant program that was aimed at expanding and subsidizing rural broadband.

Hinojosa and Democratic Sen.-elect James Talarico have also criticized Musk. While the governor-elect has made claims that Musk got tax breaks after donating to Abbott, Talarico has taken aim at the billionaire for wanting “his own personal United States senator.”
Musk has also faced criticism from Democratic lawmakers who argue that he has too much influence over the White House.
body_zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，在花费数亿美元支持共和党后，他感到“愚蠢”
周三，埃隆·马斯克在讨论他的政治立场时语气更为温和，称他并没有“盲目遵守”共和党或 MAGA 的政策。
这位科技亿万富翁在中期选举前为共和党竞选活动和特朗普盟友投入了近 5 亿美元的捐款，他是在作为唐纳德·特朗普总统代表团成员在中国参加亚太经济合作组织峰会时发表上述言论的。
“我不是 MAGA，”马斯克在接受纽约时报 DealBook 峰会采访时说道。 “如果这意味着某种程度的盲目遵守共和党的一系列政策，那么我当然不会这样做。”
马斯克在与加州民主党领导人发生冲突后，于 2020 年将公司迁至德克萨斯州。他在德克萨斯州花费了至少 1.68 亿美元，以在中期选举中支持特朗普的盟友，其中包括参议员候选人肯·帕克斯顿 (Ken Paxton) 和州长格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott)，他们都在竞选中落败。
马斯克在采访中表示，他认为民主党当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨上任后会“相当温和”。
“我不认为她是一位极左州长，根据我所听到的关于她的一切，我认为吉娜担任州长时，德克萨斯州的情况会很好，”马斯克说。
他辩称，他在竞选上花费了大量资金，因为他认为“保持一定的权力平衡是件好事”，并补充说，“一般来说”，他不希望“总统、参议院和众议院都属于同一党派”。
马斯克表示，他的目标是到 2029 年让共和党获得 51 个席位的多数席位，“顺便说一句，显然失败了”。
“我觉得自己花了这么多钱却没有看到太多好处，这真是太愚蠢了，”马斯克说。 “但这确实表明，你知道，美国选举不仅仅关乎金钱。”
他补充道，“如果我能让时钟倒转，我可能会花更少的钱。”
“我认为双方都有积极和消极的一面，”马斯克说。 “事实是，你知道，双方都有自己的问题。”
这并不是马斯克慷慨的竞选捐款第一次出现适得其反的情况。
2025 年，他向威斯康星州最高法院竞选投入了至少 2000 万美元，并向支持保守派候选人的选民提供了 100 万美元的支票，但后者最终以 10 个百分点的差距落败。
在那次竞选失败后，马斯克在 2026 年周期中基本远离了聚光灯。一些共和党人私下表示，希望马斯克保持距离，指出他2024年竞选策略的成功。
随后，马斯克在特朗普和共和党身上花费了超过 2.5 亿美元，帮助共和党赢得白宫竞选和国会控制权。
这项技术在 2026 年不起作用，尤其是在马斯克的家乡德克萨斯州，在那里他已经成为即将上任的官员的攻击目标。
即将担任下一任州总检察长的州参议员内森·约翰逊 (Nathan Johnson) 承诺将对马斯克进行调查，指控 SpaceX 不公平地从旨在扩大和补贴农村宽带的州拨款计划中受益。
伊诺霍萨和当选民主党参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科也批评了马斯克。尽管当选州长声称马斯克在向雅培捐款后获得了税收减免，但塔拉里科却将矛头指向了这位亿万富翁，因为他想要“自己的美国参议员”。
马斯克还面临民主党议员的批评，他们认为他对白宫的影响力太大。

title_en: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
title_zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉推翻了阿拉斯加州的参议院席位。而且，英伟达不会恢复黄仁勋的职位
summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.
summary_zh: 前民主党众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 赢得了美国大选之一最受关注的参议院竞选。而且，英伟达董事会表示不打算恢复前 C 级职位
body_en: Up First briefing: Mary Peltola; Trump meets Xi; Nvidia; Tech outages : NPR

Up First briefing: Mary Peltola; Trump meets Xi; Nvidia; Tech outages Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.
Your support helps make our show possible and unlocks access to our sponsor-free feed.
Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting, Nvidia Board Rejects Haung's Return, Computer System Outages

Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has defeated Republican Sen. Dan S. Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, according to The Associated Press. Her victory gives Democrats 56 senators in the upcoming Congress. Alaska uses ranked-choice voting for its general election, but Peltola secured a majority of first-place votes , eliminating the need for ranked-choice calculations. Her win flips a Senate seat in a state that President Trump won by 13 percentage points in 2024. The race's final days were tumultuous due to allegations that Peltola's team tried to recruit another candidate to the race to siphon votes from the incumbent. Peltola's campaign denied any involvement.
Mary Peltola looks on during a campaign rally at the Alaska Aviation Museum on October 30, 2026 in Anchorage, Alaska. Justin Sullivan/Getty Images hide caption

Trump has arrived in the Southern Chinese city of Shenzhen, where he is set to meet with China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday. This will mark the third time these two leaders have met this year. They are expected to discuss trade, investment and tariffs, which are currently on hold.

🎧 The meeting is about establishing a tone , as the U.S. and China have agreed to have constructive strategic stability, NPR's Jennifer Pak tells Up First . The two leaders will later be joined by Russian President Vladimir Putin for a trilateral meeting. The trio may discuss a peace deal for Russia's war in Ukraine, but China says that Europe must be included. Pak says China wants to show that a world leader won't make decisions without input from smaller countries . This is especially significant, Pak says, because these meetings take place on the sidelines of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum (APEC), where many smaller nations seek a voice in regional matters.

Nvidia board chairman Harvey Jones said in an earnings call yesterday that the board does not intend to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang. Huang "voluntarily resigned" on Nov. 12 after disclosing "personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct," according to Jones. Huang acknowledged he had been unfaithful to his wife. News reports have tied him to a woman who U.S. intelligence officials say was recruited by China's spy agency. The board unanimously accepted his resignation. Earlier yesterday, Huang said he would return as CEO if the board permitted it and agreed to testify before Congress regarding national security issues surrounding the company.

🎧 NPR's John Ruwitch said that Jones clearly wanted to dispel rumors , and showed support for interim CEO Colette Kress. He said she "has been at the center of the company's extraordinary growth." Kress also participated in the call, maintaining a business-as-usual demeanor, Ruwitch says. Nvidia posted revenue exceeding $115 billion for the quarter, which isn't surprising, as the numbers were secured before Huang's recent departure. Tech analyst Gaurav Gupta from Gartner tells Ruwitch that any impact from new leadership won't be reflected in the numbers for several months. Jones said the board would try to decide on a permanent CEO as soon as possible without rushing the decision.

Major organizations have been experiencing widespread crashes of computer and online systems. Apple reported significant outages yesterday, and the U.S. National Security Agency also experienced a breakdown. As of this morning, no major disruptions seem to be occurring. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there is no evidence that these incidents are related to one another or involve a malign actor or cybercriminal.

🎧 Cyber experts tell NPR's Greg Myre that artificial intelligence is uncovering previously undetected software flaws at an unprecedented pace. Companies are racing to patch or upgrade to address these vulnerabilities, but working under tight deadlines often leads to mistakes. As many systems undergo upgrades, people should anticipate disruptions along the way, Myre says. However, the optimistic perspective is that computer networks are expected to become more robust and resilient within the next year or two due to the improvements.

Kratom and related 7-OH products are widely available at gas stations, smoke shops, liquor stores and online. As early as Friday, the federal government could make some of the products illegal. Mindy Schauer/MediaNewsGroup/Orange County Register via Getty Images hide caption

In recent years, highly concentrated products containing 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) have emerged online and at smoke shops, liquor stores and gas stations. These products, available as tablets, gummies, tonics and chocolates, contain one of the major psychoactive ingredients in kratom. Unlike kratom leaf products, 7-OH acts more like an opioid in the human brain. Some people use kratom to maintain long-term recovery from opioid addiction. Others say it helps them feel energized or focused. Users of 7-OH and kratom can show signs of addiction, and unclear product labeling makes it hard to determine the quantities consumed. Over the past decade, the U.S. government has tried to restrict these products, but public opposition has kept them legal. Recently, this situation has started to change .

➡️ In August, the Drug Enforcement Administration restricted the manufacture and sale of three semi-synthetic opioids from 7-OH and other related compounds. They were classified under the Controlled Substances Act alongside drugs like heroin and LSD.

➡️ Kratom advocates were concerned that new rules would impact products with "trace amounts" of the opioid MGPI. The American Kratom Association filed a federal lawsuit against the DEA on Aug. 26, seeking to keep natural kratom products with MGPI legal.

➡️ On Oct. 9, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) issued a new recommendation on 7-OH and MGPI, leading the DEA to revise its stance to focus on restricting products with higher concentrations of these substances.
➡️ Opponents of the restriction argue that the products helped them avoid traditional opioids. Some point to the decrease in opioid deaths in the U.S.

➡️ The National Institute on Drug Abuse says that early studies indicate kratom and its compounds deserve more exploration as experimental treatments for substance use disorders, specifically opioid use disorder.
body_zh: 第一个简报：Mary Peltola；特朗普会见习近平；英伟达；技术中断：NPR
第一个简报：Mary Peltola；特朗普会见习近平；英伟达；技术中断前民主党众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉赢得了美国大选之一最受关注的参议院竞选。而且，英伟达董事会表示，尽管面临盟友的压力，但并不打算恢复前首席执行官黄仁勋的职位。
您的支持有助于我们的演出成为可能，并解锁我们的无赞助商动态。
特朗普-习近平-普京会议、Nvidia 董事会拒绝 Haung 回归、计算机系统中断

据美联社报道，前民主党众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉在阿拉斯加州的美国参议员竞选中击败了共和党参议员丹·S·沙利文。她的胜利使民主党在即将到来的国会中拥有 56 名参议员。阿拉斯加在大选中使用排名选择投票，但佩尔托拉获得了大多数第一名选票，从而消除了排名选择计算的需要。她的胜利扭转了特朗普总统在 2024 年以 13 个百分点获胜的州的参议院席位。由于有人指控佩尔托拉的团队试图招募另一位候选人参加竞选，以从现任总统手中夺取选票，因此竞选的最后几天非常混乱。佩尔托拉的竞选团队否认有任何参与。
2026 年 10 月 30 日，玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 在阿拉斯加安克雷奇的阿拉斯加航空博物馆观看竞选集会。贾斯汀·沙利文/盖蒂图片社隐藏标题栏
特朗普已抵达中国南方城市深圳，定于周四与中国国家主席习近平会面。这将是两位领导人今年第三次会面。预计他们将讨论目前搁置的贸易、投资和关税问题。

🎧 NPR 的 Jennifer Pak 告诉 Up First ，这次会议是为了确定基调，因为美国和中国已经同意建立建设性的战略稳定。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京随后将与两位领导人一起举行三边会议。三人可能会讨论俄罗斯乌克兰战争的和平协议，但中国表示欧洲必须参与其中。朴说，中国希望表明，世界领导人不会在没有小国参与的情况下做出决定。帕克说，这一点尤其重要，因为这些会议是在亚太经济合作论坛（APEC）期间举行的，许多小国在该论坛上寻求在地区事务中发表意见。

英伟达董事会主席哈维琼斯在昨天的财报电话会议上表示，董事会不打算恢复前首席执行官黄仁勋的职位。琼斯表示，黄在披露“个人行为不符合公司行为准则”后，于 11 月 12 日“主动辞职”。黄承认他对妻子不忠。新闻报道称他与一名女性有联系，美国情报官员称该女性是由中国间谍机构招募的。董事会一致接受了他的辞职。昨天早些时候，黄仁勋表示，如果董事会允许，他将重新担任首席执行官，并同意就公司的国家安全问题在国会作证。

🎧 NPR 的 John Ruwitch 表示，琼斯显然是想辟谣，并对临时首席执行官 Colette Kress 表示支持。他说她“一直是公司非凡发展的核心”。鲁维奇说，克雷斯也参加了电话会议，保持着一切如常的态度。 Nvidia 公布本季度收入超过 1150 亿美元，这并不奇怪，因为这些数字在黄最近离职之前就已经确定了。 Gartner 的技术分析师 Gaurav Gupta 告诉 Ruwitch，新领导层的任何影响在几个月内都不会反映在数据中。琼斯表示，董事会将尽力尽快决定永久首席执行官的人选，但不会仓促做出决定。
主要组织都经历过广泛的计算机和在线系统崩溃。苹果公司昨天报告了严重的服务中断，美国国家安全局也出现了故障。截至今天早上，似乎没有发生重大干扰。美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，没有证据表明这些事件相互关联或涉及恶意行为者或网络犯罪分子。
🎧 网络专家告诉 NPR 的 Greg Myre，人工智能正在以前所未有的速度发现以前未被发现的软件缺陷。公司正在竞相修补或升级以解决这些漏洞，但在紧迫的期限内工作往往会导致错误。迈尔说，随着许多系统进行升级，人们应该预见到升级过程中可能会出现的中断。然而，乐观的观点是，由于这些改进，计算机网络预计将在未来一两年内变得更加强大和有弹性。
卡痛及相关 7-OH 产品在加油站、烟店、酒类商店和网上广泛销售。最早在周五，联邦政府可能会将某些产品定为非法。 Mindy Schauer/MediaNewsGroup/Orange County Register 通过 Getty Images 隐藏标题栏

近年来，含有 7-羟基帽柱木碱 (7-OH) 的高浓度产品出现在网上以及烟店、酒类商店和加油站。这些产品以片剂、软糖、补品和巧克力的形式提供，含有卡痛叶中主要的精神活性成分之一。与卡痛叶产品不同，7-OH 在人脑中的作用更像是阿片类药物。有些人使用卡痛叶来维持阿片类药物成瘾的长期康复。其他人则表示这可以帮助他们感到精力充沛或集中注意力。 7-OH 和卡痛叶的使用者可能会表现出上瘾的迹象，而且产品标签不明确导致很难确定食用量。过去十年来，美国政府一直试图限制这些产品，但公众的反对使它们保持合法。最近，这种情况开始发生变化。
➡️ 8 月，缉毒局限制生产和销售三种由 7-OH 和其他相关化合物制成的半合成阿片类药物。它们与海洛因和迷幻药等毒品一起​​被归入《管制物质法》。
➡️ Kratom 的支持者担心新规则会影响含有“微量”阿片类药物 MGPI 的产品。美国卡痛叶协会于8月26日对DEA提起联邦诉讼，寻求保持具有MGPI的天然卡痛叶产品的合法性。
➡️10月9日，美国卫生与公众服务部（HHS）发布了关于7-OH和MGPI的新建议，导致DEA修改立场，重点限制这些物质浓度较高的产品。
➡️ 该限制的反对者认为，这些产品帮助他们避免了传统的阿片类药物。一些人指出美国阿片类药物死亡人数有所下降
➡️国家药物滥用研究所表示，早期研究表明卡痛叶及其化合物值得更多探索，作为物质使用障碍（特别是阿片类药物使用障碍）的实验治疗方法。

title_en: Elon Musk claims ‘I’m not Maga’ and says he regrets vast sums to back Republicans
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克声称“我不是马加”，并表示他对巨额资金支持共和党感到遗憾
summary: Musk, who aligned with Trump and was frequent White House guest, says he feels ‘pretty foolish’ about record midterm spending Elon Musk denied being Maga on Wednesday, despite aligning himself intensely with Donald Trump’s Make America Great Again movement sin
summary_zh: 与特朗普结盟并经常成为白宫客人的马斯克表示，他对创纪录的中期支出感到“非常愚蠢”，埃隆·马斯克否认自己是特朗普总统。
body_en: Elon Musk claims ‘I’m not Maga’ and says he regrets vast sums to back Republicans | US politics
Musk, who aligned with Trump and was frequent White House guest, says he feels ‘pretty foolish’ about record midterm spending
Elon Musk denied being Maga on Wednesday, despite aligning himself intensely with Donald Trump’s Make America Great Again movement since 2024.

“I’m not Maga,” the world’s richest person told the New York Times Dealbook summit, which he attended via video call from China, where he is one of several US business leaders who have accompanied Trump on his trip to Asia.

“I’m not sure what Maga means, but if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican party, then I certainly don’t have that,” the chief executive of SpaceX and Tesla added.
Musk famously declared at a 2024 campaign rally in Madison Square Garden: “I’m not just Maga. I’m dark, gothic Maga.”

In a 45-minute interview with Andrew Ross Sorkin, a New York Times columnist, Musk also said it would be good for Washington to have split control between the two parties, and that he thinks “there are positives and negatives in both”.
Elon Musk’s nearly half a billion dollars in midterms spending was a flop

He also accused Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, of “lying” about restrictions on access to his firm’s Starshield satellite system ; praised Jensen Huang, the ousted Nvidia chief executive; and said that “no one I met at Anthropic set off my evil detector”.

Asked about his previous negative comments about Anthropic, Musk said that before he agreed to rent computing power to the AI firm: “I went to met with a lot of people at Anthropic. I didn’t just move forward with the deal.”
“My interaction so far with the Anthropic team is that they seem like good people and they seem principled,” Musk added. “They seem diligent and they seem seem to care about the future.”
Musk donated at least $250m of his own money to help Trump win the election in 2024, and recently spent nearly $500m in the US midterms to support Republicans, many of whom lost.

Musk admitted at the Dealbook summit that his spending had “failed”, and that he felt “pretty foolish” for spending such a sum, the most that anyone has ever spent in a political cycle when they themselves did not run for office. “It certainly shows that American elections are not just about money,” he said. “If I could rewind the clock, I would have spent less money.”

After Trump took office for the second time in 2025, Musk served for 180 days heading the so-called “department of government efficiency” (Doge) within Trump’s administration, before stepping down following a very public falling out with the president.

That culminated in Musk posting on his social media platform in June of that year: “Time to drop the really big bomb: @realDonaldTrump is in the Epstein files. That is the real reason they have not been made public.”

The two men later reconciled. During his time leading Doge, Musk frequently appeared in the Oval Office and at cabinet meetings alongside the president, often sporting hats that read “Make America Great Again” or “Trump was right about everything”.
body_zh: 埃隆·马斯克声称“我不是马加”，并表示他对巨额资金支持共和党感到遗憾美国政治
与特朗普结盟并经常成为白宫客人的马斯克表示，他对创纪录的中期支出感到“非常愚蠢”
埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周三否认自己是 Maga，尽管他自 2024 年以来一直积极支持唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 的“让美国再次伟大”运动。
“我不是马加，”这位世界首富在《纽约时报》Dealbook峰会上表示，他是在中国通过视频通话参加的。他是陪同特朗普亚洲之行的几位美国商界领袖之一。
“我不确定 Maga 的意思，但如果这意味着盲目遵守共和党的一系列政策，那么我当然不这么认为，”SpaceX 和特斯拉的首席执行官补充道。
马斯克在麦迪逊广场花园举行的 2024 年竞选集会上发表了一句著名的宣言：“我不仅仅是 Maga。我是黑暗、哥特式的 Maga。”
在接受《纽约时报》专栏作家安德鲁·罗斯·索金（Andrew Ross Sorkin）长达 45 分钟的采访时，马斯克还表示，两党分开控制对华盛顿来说是件好事，他认为“两者都有积极和消极的一面”。
埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在中期选举中近 5 亿美元的支出是失败的
他还指责乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)在限制访问其公司的星盾卫星系统的问题上“撒谎”；赞扬被罢免的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋；并说“我在 Anthropic 遇到的任何人都没有触发我的邪恶探测器”。
当被问及之前对 Anthropic 的负面评论时，马斯克表示，在他同意向这家人工智能公司出租计算能力之前：“我去见了 Anthropic 的很多人。我并没有只是推进这笔交易。”
“到目前为止，我与 Anthropic 团队的互动是，他们看起来都是好人，而且很有原则，”马斯克补充道。 “他们看起来很勤奋，而且似乎关心未来。”
马斯克捐赠了至少 2.5 亿美元的自有资金来帮助特朗普赢得 2024 年的大选，并且最近在美国中期选举中花费了近 5 亿美元来支持共和党，其中许多人失败了。
马斯克在 Dealbook 峰会上承认，他的支出“失败了”，他觉得花掉如此一笔资金“相当愚蠢”，这是他们自己没有竞选公职时在政治周期中花过的最多的一笔钱。 “这无疑表明美国选举不仅仅关乎金钱，”他说。 “如果我能让时钟倒转，我就会花更少的钱。”
2025 年特朗普第二次上任后，马斯克在特朗普政府内担任所谓“政府效率部”(Doge) 的负责人 180 天，随后因与总统公开争吵而辞职。
当年 6 月，马斯克在他的社交媒体平台上发帖称：“是时候投下真正的大炸弹了：@realDonaldTrump 就在爱泼斯坦的档案中。这就是它们没有被公开的真正原因。”
两人后来和解了。在领导总督期间，马斯克经常与总统一起出现在椭圆形办公室和内阁会议上，经常戴着写着“让美国再次伟大”或“特朗普在所有事情上都是对的”的帽子。

title_en: Record-breaking rain lashes California’s Bay area as ‘atmospheric river’ arrives
title_zh: “大气河”到来，破纪录的降雨袭击了加州湾区
summary: Storm expected to move into southern California, with LA residents warned of potential evacuation orders Heavy rain pounded California’s Bay area, with record rainfall in downtown San Francisco and flooding and power outages across the region, as an “atmospher
summary_zh: 风暴预计将进入南加州，洛杉矶居民收到潜在疏散令的警告 大雨袭击了加州湾区，其中包括
body_en: Storm expected to move into southern California, with LA residents warned of potential evacuation orders

Heavy rain pounded California’s Bay area, with record rainfall in downtown San Francisco and flooding and power outages across the region, as an “atmospheric river” arrived on Wednesday and dumped precipitation across the state.

The storm was expected to move into southern California on Wednesday night and Thursday, with Los Angeles warning residents in mudslide-prone areas of potential evacuation orders to come. Southern Californians were also warned of potential coastal flooding, heavy surf, wave damage to coastal piers and parking lots and beach sand erosion. Heavy snow warnings were issued for higher elevations of the Sierra Mountains, including in the Greater Lake Tahoe area.
A map of the US west showing rainfall totals.

Downtown San Francisco saw the most rainfall before noon in 76 years, at 2.11in, surpassing a record from 1950, the San Francisco Chronicle reported . By 3pm, Wednesday’s daily total of 2.28in had broken the record for the most rainfall on 18 November, which was previously set in 1918 , the National Weather Service reported. South of San Francisco, in Santa Clara, there was flooding and standing water on several highways.

In San Jose, the local fire department posted on social media that two vehicles with passengers inside had become stranded in the flooded streets downtown near the SAP Center, the city’s major events arena. The second passenger was being extricated via a boat rescue, the department wrote.
Daniel Lurie, the San Francisco mayor, warned city residents the region’s winter storm and flood season, supercharged by this year’s very strong El Niño weather, was just getting started.
Despite the Wednesday afternoon break in the rain, he posted on social media, “The storm should pick back up tonight, and more rain is in the forecast for next week.”
“When these heavy storms come, we expect flooding to return to many of the same areas that were impacted this morning,” he added.
“Today’s storm certainly gave the Bay Area a good assessment of our pain points for future storms this season,” Drew Tuma, a local meteorologist for ABC7 News, wrote on social media .

Street flooding in San Francisco left maintenance hole covers floating in one neighborhood of San Francisco, while the self-driving car company Waymo temporarily suspended service in the city, the Chronicle reported. One Waymo stalled in a flooded street and blocked traffic , ABC7 News reported.

An overwhelmed sewer stormwater system also appeared to result in several “sewage geysers”, one reportedly 15-ft tall , the Chronicle reported, sharing bystander footage of the spew in the city’s Ocean Beach neighborhood.
Big wave surfers line up to ride ‘raw power of the Pacific’ during Super El Niño swells

Thousands across the Bay area were dealing with storm-related power outages by Wednesday afternoon, according to a customer outage map from Pacific Gas & Electric, the major utility company for much of northern California.

In Monterey, south of San Francisco, the local aquarium posted on social media that “storms and massive waves are causing a surge of sea otter strandings this week in Monterey Bay” and that their staff “safely rescued several pups” after receiving calls from local community members.
Areas of the state still recovering from recent wildfires continue to be at risk for flash flooding, with specific warnings issued for “burn scar” areas including in Big Sur and the Napa valley .

In Los Angeles, city officials warned residents of areas burned by the 2025 Palisades, Sunset and Hurst fires, north of the city, to be prepared for potential evacuation orders starting on Wednesday night, as heavy rains brought increased risk of flooding, mudslide and debris flow.

Statewide, the heaviest of the rainfall was expected north-east of San Francisco, from Santa Rosa to Chico and Redding in the state’s Central valley, and in the southern part of the Bay Area, along coastal mountain ranges from Santa Cruz to San Jose and Palo Alto, according to the National Weather Service .
“Travel delays, localized flooding and hazardous conditions are possible, especially along the coast and on mountain pass roads,” AccuWeather warned in an online forecast .
body_zh: 风暴预计将进入南加州，洛杉矶居民收到潜在疏散令的警告
大雨袭击了加州湾区，旧金山市中心降雨量创历史新高，整个地区出现洪水和停电，一条“大气河”于周三抵达，给全州带来了降水。
预计风暴将于周三晚上和周四进入南加州，洛杉矶警告泥石流易发地区的居民可能会收到疏散令。南加州人还被警告可能出现沿海洪水、巨浪、海浪对沿海码头和停车场的破坏以及海滩沙子侵蚀。内华达山脉高海拔地区（包括大太浩湖地区）发布了大雪警告。
显示降雨总量的美国西部地图。
据《旧金山纪事报》报道，旧金山市中心正午前降雨量达到 2.11 英寸，为 76 年来最多，超过了 1950 年的记录。据国家气象局报道，到下午 3 点，周三的每日总降雨量达到 2.28 英寸，打破了 11 月 18 日的最大降雨量记录，该记录是 1918 年创下的。旧金山以南的圣克拉拉，多条高速公路出现洪水和积水。
在圣何塞，当地消防部门在社交媒体上发布消息称，两辆载有乘客的车辆被困在该市主要活动场地 SAP 中心附近被洪水淹没的市中心街道上。该部门写道，第二名乘客正在通过船只救援被救出。
旧金山市长丹尼尔·卢里（Daniel Lurie）警告城市居民，该地区的冬季风暴和洪水季节才刚刚开始，今年强烈的厄尔尼诺天气加剧了这一现象。
尽管周三下午下雨，但他在社交媒体上发帖称，“今晚风暴应该会再次加剧，预计下周会有更多降雨。”
他补充说：“当这些强风暴来袭时，我们预计今天早上受影响的许多地区将再次出现洪水。”
ABC7 News 的当地气象学家德鲁·图马 (Drew Tuma) 在社交媒体上写道：“今天的风暴无疑让湾区对本季未来风暴的痛点有了很好的评估。”
据《纪事报》报道，旧金山街道洪水导致旧金山一个街区的维护孔盖漂浮，而自动驾驶汽车公司 Waymo 暂时停止了在该市的服务。据 ABC7 News 报道，一辆 Waymo 在被洪水淹没的街道上抛锚并堵塞了交通。
据《纪事报》报道，不堪重负的下水道雨水系统似乎还形成了几个“污水间歇泉”，据报道其中一个高达 15 英尺，并分享了旁观者在该市海洋海滩附近拍摄到的喷涌镜头。
超级厄尔尼诺现象期间，巨浪冲浪者排队享受“太平洋的原始力量”
根据太平洋天然气电力公司（北加州大部分地区的主要公用事业公司）的客户停电地图，截至周三下午，湾区数千人正面临与风暴相关的停电问题。
在旧金山南部的蒙特利，当地水族馆在社交媒体上发帖称，“本周，风暴和巨浪导致蒙特利湾搁浅的海獭数量激增”，他们的工作人员在接到当地社区成员的电话后，“安全地救出了几只海獭幼崽”。
该州仍在从最近的野火中恢复的地区继续面临山洪爆发的风险，针对包括大苏尔和纳帕山谷在内的“烧伤疤痕”地区发出了具体警告。
在洛杉矶，市政府官员警告该市北部 2025 年 Palisades、Sunset 和 Hurst 火灾烧毁地区的居民，要为周三晚上开始的可能的疏散命令做好准备，因为大雨带来了洪水、泥石流和泥石流的风险增加。
据国家气象局称，全州范围内，预计降雨量最大的地区是旧金山东北部，从该州中央山谷的圣罗莎到奇科和雷丁，以及湾区南部，从圣克鲁斯到圣何塞和帕洛阿尔托的沿海山脉。
AccuWeather 在在线预报中警告说：“旅行延误、局部洪水和危险情况是可能发生的，特别是在沿海地区和山口道路上。”

title_en: ‘A savagely brutal map’: Senate GOP braces for 2028
title_zh: “一张极其残酷的地图”：参议院共和党为 2028 年做好准备
summary: Sen. Bernie Moreno, the incoming chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, is clear-eyed on the challenges ahead as the party reckons with midterm losses.
summary_zh: 共和党全国参议院委员会即将上任的主席参议员伯尼·莫雷诺（Bernie Moreno）对未来的挑战有着清醒的认识，因为该党认为自己的智慧
body_en: Sen. Bernie Moreno isn’t sugarcoating things.

The incoming chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee will be in charge of defending 19 GOP seats in 2028 — and he’ll need to flip at least six more to regain control of the Senate majority.
“Looking at it right now, it's absolutely a savagely brutal map,” the Ohio Republican said in an interview on Capitol Hill.
After a historic midterms shellacking, Moreno is in the hot seat as he looks to navigate his chamber — and the party — through a rebuilding of its brand and its base over next two years.

Republicans will likely have just 44 seats heading into 2028. They need to hold onto seats in battleground states like Wisconsin and North Carolina, while trying to flip seats held by Democratic Sens. Mark Kelly in Arizona, John Fetterman in Pennsylvania, Raphael Warnock in Georgia and Catherine Cortez Masto in Nevada.

Moreno and his team have interviewed a handful of candidates over the last few days to be the next NRSC executive director, according to four people with direct knowledge of the matter, granted anonymity to discuss private conversations. Republicans expect Chris Grant, a former Moreno and Trump campaign staffer who now runs his own firm, to serve as a main outside GOP consultant for the committee.

On top of the grueling map ahead, the Ohio Republican is facing the additional task of working with a lame duck president who still wields immense power over the GOP and its primaries. Then there’s the vice president, who is likely to run for president himself in the same two-year sprint.
Moreno is close with both of those men. Asked how involved he expects the White House to be in GOP primaries and recruiting going forward, he replied, “We’re going to work on all of that.”

It’ll be a complicated path forward. Moreno, over the past cycle has been unwilling to cast blame on President Donald Trump or Vice President JD Vance. Days before the midterm elections, he said if Republicans lost, it would be because people were “pissed off” about high gas prices. He’s unlikely to completely distance himself and the NRSC brand from the president's influence.

But the party is currently undergoing a reckoning of how closely to align with the president after voters delivered an uncompromising rebuke of Trump’s economic agenda. Across the country, several battlegrounds and once-thought-to-be-safe red territory fell to Democratic hands.

Trump in the 2026 cycle angered many Senate Republicans by supporting a primary challenge against Sen. John Cornyn of Texas — a move they privately say cost them north of $200 million as they tried, in vain, to save Ken Paxton’s imperiled campaign. The president also supported a primary challenge against Sen. Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, and pushed Sen. Thom Tillis to decide to retire in highly competitive North Carolina.

One of the biggest challenges before Moreno and Senate Republicans after the midterms wipeout is to find candidates who can win a general election in highly competitive states, while also making it through GOP primaries where Trump will be a major factor. They’ll need to push back on the White House if the president tries, once again, to intervene — though that’s easier said than done.

“There will be no patience for bad recruits this cycle,” said one senior Republican granted anonymity to discuss internal conversations, referring to the implosions of Paxton, Michael Whatley in North Carolina and other Republicans who were hand-picked by Trump.

The White House referred POLITICO to Trump's post-midterms comments, where he blamed his party’s losses on the fact that he wasn’t on the ballot and said he brought several candidates "closer to victory," though they ultimately lost.

Senate Majority Leader John Thune — who will be the minority leader next year — and his team plan to be heavily involved in recruitment efforts, according to two people involved in the conversations, granted anonymity to speak candidly.
Their goal, one of the people said, is “to make sure we have our strongest possible candidates on the ballot in 2028.”

Moreno is already trying to find a GOP recruit in his home state of Ohio to run against incoming Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown, whose term will be up again in 2028 after he won a special election against GOP Sen. Jon Husted earlier this month.
The new NRSC chair said he’s looking for “somebody who can beat the crap out of Sherrod Brown.”

Husted in private conversations hasn’t completely ruled out another bid, but he’s indicated he’s unlikely to run again, according to three people with knowledge of the matter, granted anonymity to speak candidly. Ohio Republicans expect former state Sen. Kevin Coughlin to explore a potential Senate bid. And they’re watching Rep. Mike Turner (R-Ohio), who just lost his reelection.

Husted did not respond to a request for comment. A Turner spokesperson said in a statement that the representative "has been approached by several people about this and is keeping all his options open.”
body_zh: 参议员伯尼·莫雷诺并没有粉饰事实。
即将上任的全国共和党参议院委员会主席将负责在 2028 年捍卫 19 个共和党席位，而他还需要至少再推翻 6 个席位才能重新获得参议院多数席位的控制权。
“现在看来，这绝对是一张极其残酷的地图，”这位俄亥俄州共和党人在国会山接受采访时表示。
在经历了历史性的中期选举惨败之后，莫雷诺陷入了困境，他希望在未来两年内通过重建其品牌和基础来引导他的议院和政党。
到2028年，共和党可能只剩下44个席位。他们需要保住威斯康星州和北卡罗来纳州等战场州的席位，同时试图扭转民主党参议员马克·凯利(亚利桑那州)、约翰·费特曼(宾夕法尼亚州)、拉斐尔·沃诺克(佐治亚州)和凯瑟琳·科尔特斯·马斯托(内华达州)所占据的席位。
据四位直接了解此事的人士透露，莫雷诺和他的团队在过去几天采访了几位下一任 NRSC 执行董事的候选人，他们要求匿名讨论私人谈话。共和党人预计前莫雷诺和特朗普竞选团队工作人员、现在经营自己公司的克里斯·格兰特将担任该委员会的主要共和党外部顾问。
除了前面的艰巨任务之外，这位俄亥俄州共和党人还面临着与一位仍然对共和党及其初选拥有巨大权力的跛脚鸭总统合作的额外任务。然后是副总统，他很可能在同一个两年冲刺中亲自竞选总统。
莫雷诺与这两个人关系密切。当被问及他希望白宫如何参与共和党初选和未来的招募时，他回答说：“我们将致力于所有这些工作。”
这将是一条复杂的前进道路。莫雷诺在过去的一个周期中一直不愿意将责任归咎于唐纳德·特朗普总统或副总统万斯。在中期选举前几天，他表示，如果共和党失败，那将是因为人们对高油价感到“愤怒”。他不太可能让自己和 NRSC 品牌完全摆脱总统的影响。
但在选民对特朗普的经济议程进行了毫不妥协的谴责后，该党目前正在考虑与总统保持何种程度的一致。在全国范围内，几个战场和曾经被认为安全的红色领土落入民主党手中。
特朗普在 2026 年周期中支持对德克萨斯州参议员约翰·科宁 (John Cornyn) 进行初选挑战，激怒了许多参议院共和党人。他们私下称，这一举动让他们损失了超过 2 亿美元，因为他们试图挽救肯·帕克斯顿 (Ken Paxton) 岌岌可危的竞选活动，但徒劳无功。总统还支持对路易斯安那州参议员比尔·卡西迪发起初选挑战，并敦促参议员托姆·蒂利斯决定在竞争激烈的北卡罗来纳州退休。
中期选举惨败后，莫雷诺和参议院共和党人面临的最大挑战之一是找到能够在竞争激烈的州赢得大选的候选人，同时还能通过特朗普将成为主要因素的共和党初选。如果总统再次试图干预，他们将需要向白宫施压——尽管这说起来容易做起来难。
一位不愿透露姓名的共和党资深人士在讨论内部对话时表示，“这个周期对糟糕的新人不会有耐心”，他指的是帕克斯顿、北卡罗来纳州的迈克尔·沃特利和特朗普亲自挑选的其他共和党人的内爆。
白宫向《政治》杂志提及了特朗普在中期选举后的言论，特朗普将党派的失利归咎于他没有参加投票，并表示他让几位候选人“更接近胜利”，尽管他们最终失败了。
据两名参与对话的人士透露，参议院多数党领袖约翰·图恩（明年将成为少数党领袖）和他的团队计划大力参与招聘工作，但不愿透露姓名。
其中一位知情人士表示，他们的目标是“确保 2028 年的选票上有最强的候选人。”
莫雷诺已经在他的家乡俄亥俄州寻找一名共和党新成员，与即将上任的民主党参议员谢罗德·布朗(Sherrod Brown)竞争。本月早些时候，他在特别选举中击败了共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德(Jon Husted)，后者的任期将在2028年再次延长。
新任 NRSC 主席表示，他正在寻找“能打败谢罗德·布朗的人”。
据三位不愿透露姓名的知情人士坦言，在私下谈话中，赫斯特德并没有完全排除再次竞选的可能性，但他表示自己不太可能再次参选。俄亥俄州共和党人预计前州参议员凯文·考夫林将探讨潜在的参议院竞选。他们正在关注刚刚失去连任的众议员迈克·特纳（俄亥俄州共和党人）。
赫斯特德没有回应置评请求。特纳发言人在一份声明中表示，“已经有几个人就此事与该代表接洽，并保留所有选择。”

title_en: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
title_zh: 特朗普抵达中国，将与习近平和普京进行重要会晤
summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.
summary_zh: 空军一号抵达深圳后，习近平在停机坪上向特朗普致意，回应美国总统的举动
body_en: China's President Xi Jinping, center, stands as President Trump, left, and Russian President Vladimir Putin shake hands before the welcome banquet at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, China, Wednesday. Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press via AP hide caption

SHENZHEN, China — President Donald Trump plans to meet separately with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday in China, in addition to their already scheduled three-way meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, a U.S. official confirmed.
Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
Trump's meeting with Putin would be the first time that the leaders have held talks since their discussions in Alaska last year that failed to broker a deal to ease Russia's war in Ukraine.
Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting

Trump has frequently boasted of his rapport with Putin as relations between the United States and Ukraine appear to have cratered recently. Trump rejected new Russia sanctions while Kyiv was undermined by disruptions in satellite support for its drones during the war.
The U.S. official who confirmed the Trump-Putin meeting in China spoke to The Associated Press on the condition of anonymity to share plans that were not yet public.
The exact timing of the meeting on Thursday was unclear. Trump already had public plans for a separate meeting with Xi and a historic trilateral meeting with Xi and Putin.
FAA blames Friday's ground stop on 'equipment issue' during telecoms network upgrade

Trump said he plans to talk with Xi and Putin in their joint meeting about limiting nuclear weapons and bringing an end to the war in Ukraine, which began in 2022 with Russia's invasion. Analysts are not expecting substantive breakthroughs despite the unprecedented nature of the meeting.

Before the trip, Trump's aides told reporters that the war in Ukraine would not be on the agenda. But Trump said on Tuesday that the deaths of tens of thousands of Russian troops every month had created an opening to resolve the conflict.

Russian President Vladimir Putin speaks at the APEC CEO summit held ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, southern China's Guangdong province on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. Dmitry Azarov/Pool Sputnik Kremlin hide caption
"I think it's very close to getting it done," the Republican president said. "We're going to have a good meeting on that."
Trump lands in China's tech hub as outages cause concerns at home

Trump landed in China on Wednesday seeking to reinforce America's status as the world's leading technology power, but a distressing series of technical outages back home has left his administration scrambling to calm the U.S. public.
The issues put the administration on the defensive at a moment when the president wants to project strength and certainty before the meeting with Xi and Putin.

As he began his trip to Asia, Trump initially had been nonchalant about the outages that left people in the U.S. worried about accessing their email, checking their bank accounts or safely flying on an airplane.
"It's fine," Trump said Tuesday from the Philippine capital of Manila, suggesting it was all just a consequence of being a nation that is "big and powerful."

But then the outages involving Microsoft, the Federal Aviation Administration, JPMorgan Chase and the National Security Agency's communications network began to overshadow Trump's visit. They raised the specter that artificial intelligence can disrupt daily life, as new cyber vulnerabilities identified require software to be constantly upgraded to fix flaws or other security holes, known as patching, which is supposed to improve how the technology runs.
