title_en: Florida pastor found guilty over 2021 assassination of Haitian president
title_zh: 佛罗里达州牧师因 2021 年刺杀海地总统而被判有罪
summary: Christian Emmanuel Sanon faces life in prison after conviction on charges arising from killing of Jovenel Moïse A Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship was convicted on Wednesday of US charges arising from the 2021 assassination of the Haitian
summary_zh: 克里斯蒂安·伊曼纽尔·萨农 (Christian Emmanuel Sanon) 因杀害拥有海地裔美国血统的佛罗里达州牧师乔弗内尔·莫伊兹 (Jovenel Moïse) 被定罪，面临终身监禁
body_en: Christian Emmanuel Sanon faces life in prison after conviction on charges arising from killing of Jovenel Moïse
A Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship was convicted on Wednesday of US charges arising from the 2021 assassination of the Haitian president Jovenel Moïse.

Christian Emmanuel Sanon was found guilty on charges including conspiring to kill Moïse after a nearly eight-week trial in federal court in Miami . He had faced a total of eight charges including conspiracy to kidnap or kill a person outside the United States.

Federal prosecutors said south Florida was a hub for planning and financing the plot to oust Moïse and install a president of the conspirators’ choosing. The government said Sanon was the conspirators’ initial choice for Moïse’s replacement. Prosecutors also said Sanon helped raise money for the conspiracy and arranged travel to Haiti and lodging for himself and others in that country.

Sanon acknowledged in trial testimony that he was in communication at one point with people trying to replace Moïse, but pointed out that the group had moved on to another candidate long before the assassination. He denied any knowledge of plans to kill Moïse.
Sanon was born in Haiti and moved to the US as a teenager. He testified that he worked with churches in Haitian immigrant communities in Florida and the midwest.

Haiti has not had a president since authorities said that a squad of mostly retired Colombian soldiers killed Moïse and wounded his wife in a night-time raid at their home on 7 July 2021. The poorest country in the Americas , Haiti has a history of dictatorship, political upheaval and foreign intervention that has long hindered democratic rule.
The election of a new president is scheduled for next year.

Prosecutors said the scheme to kill Moïse included paying about two dozen foreign mercenaries with money obtained from US government programs that were intended to help businesses during the Covid pandemic, according to court records. US prosecutors have charged more than 40 people with crimes related to the assassination and a dozen have been convicted, including five who are serving life sentences.

The plot to oust Moïse began taking final shape in April 2021, when Sanon met in south Florida with a former Haitian senator and several US businesspeople, according to an indictment. The group agreed that Sanon, once in power, would award contracts to two Florida-based companies – Counter Terrorist Unit Federal Academy and Counter Terrorist Unit Security, collectively known as CTU – for infrastructure projects, security forces and military equipment, according to investigators.

CTU initially hired about 18 Colombian nationals with military training to provide security for Sanon, according to prosecutors. Conspirators also spent months obtaining weapons and body armor and attempting to build ties with Haitian gangs, officials said.

By June 2021, the conspirators realized Sanon had neither the constitutional qualifications nor sufficient popular support to become president. They shifted their support to Wendelle Coq Thélot, a former Haitian supreme court judge who died in January 2025 while a fugitive.
Sanon was previously scheduled to be tried with four other men who were convicted earlier this year, but his case was separated from theirs and delayed for health reasons.
body_zh: 克里斯蒂安·伊曼纽尔·萨农 (Christian Emmanuel Sanon) 因谋杀若弗内尔·莫伊兹 (Jovenel Moïse) 被定罪，面临终身监禁
周三，一名拥有海地美国双重国籍的佛罗里达州牧师因美国对 2021 年暗杀海地总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹的指控而被定罪。
在迈阿密联邦法院经过近八周的审判后，克里斯蒂安·伊曼纽尔·萨农被判有罪，罪名包括密谋杀害莫伊兹。他总共面临八项指控，包括串谋绑架或杀害美国境外的人。
联邦检察官表示，南佛罗里达州是策划和资助推翻莫伊兹并扶植共谋者选择的总统的阴谋的中心。政府表示，萨农是共谋者最初选择接替莫伊兹的人选。检察官还表示，萨农帮助为这一阴谋筹集资金，并为自己和该国其他人安排前往海地的旅行和住宿。
萨农在审判证词中承认，他曾一度与试图取代莫伊兹的人进行过沟通，但指出该组织早在暗杀事件发生之前就已经转向了另一位候选人。他否认了解杀害莫伊兹的计划。
萨农出生于海地，青少年时期移居美国。他作证说，他与佛罗里达州和中西部海地移民社区的教会合作。
当局表示，2021 年 7 月 7 日，一队大部分是退役的哥伦比亚士兵在一次夜间袭击莫伊兹家中杀死了莫伊兹并打伤了他的妻子，此后海地就没有总统了。海地是美洲最贫穷的国家，有着独裁、政治动荡和外国干预的历史，长期以来阻碍了民主统治。
新总统的选举定于明年举行。
法庭记录显示，检察官表示，杀害莫伊兹的计划包括向大约两打外国雇佣兵支付从美国政府项目获得的资金，这些项目旨在在新冠大流行期间帮助企业。美国检察官已指控 40 多人犯有与暗杀有关的罪行，十几人已被定罪，其中 5 人正在服无期徒刑。
起诉书称，驱逐莫伊兹的阴谋于 2021 年 4 月开始最终成形，当时萨农在佛罗里达州南部与一名前海地参议员和几名美国商人会面。据调查人员称，该组织同意，萨农一旦掌权，将向两家总部位于佛罗里达州的公司——联邦学院反恐单位和安全反恐单位（统称为 CTU）授予基础设施项目、安全部队和军事装备合同。
据检察官称，CTU 最初雇佣了约 18 名受过军事训练的哥伦比亚国民，为萨农提供安全保障。官员称，共谋者还花了几个月的时间获取武器和防弹衣，并试图与海地帮派建立联系。
到 2021 年 6 月，阴谋者意识到萨农既不具备成为总统的宪法资格，也没有足够的民众支持。他们将支持转向前海地最高法院法官温德尔·科克·泰洛 (Wendelle Coq Thélot)，她于 2025 年 1 月在逃亡期间去世。
萨农原本计划与今年早些时候被定罪的其他四名男子一起受审，但他的案件与他们的案件分开审理，并因健康原因而被推迟。

title_en: Trump abandons his FDA nominee, and Senate scraps vote on his NSF pick
title_zh: 特朗普放弃了 FDA 提名人，参议院取消了对 NSF 人选的投票
summary: "This time requires leadership and fortitude," Senator Bill Cassidy said.
summary_zh: “这一次需要领导力和毅力，”参议员比尔·卡西迪说。
body_en: In the span of less than 24 hours, two Trump administration nominees have suffered sudden blows—Trump's pick to lead the Food and Drug Administration and his pick to lead the National Science Foundation.

Late Tuesday evening, Axios reported that the White House had abruptly withdrawn its controversial nomination of Heidi Overton to lead the FDA. Overton, a top conservative domestic policy aide in the White House, has drawn criticism and skepticism from Republicans and Democrats alike over her stances on vaccines, abortion, vapes, and birth control. Overton opposes abortion—though perhaps not strongly enough for some Republicans—and supported Trump and Kennedy's decried anti-vaccine policies and statements, vexing Democrats.

In her confirmation hearing in September, Overton consistently stonewalled senators on every topic, refusing to directly answer even softball questions from friendly Republicans, leaving lawmakers on both sides of the aisle openly frustrated. The questions she dodged included those on how she would handle the FDA's current safety review of the abortion pill, mifepristone, which extensive data has established is extremely safe. She also wouldn't say whether she agreed with Trump when he falsely claimed the measles vaccine is "quite lethal" or that children are given vaccine doses the "size of a soda bottle." Overton repeatedly refused to answer whether Trump could ever be wrong.
body_zh: 在不到24小时的时间里，特朗普政府的两名提名人突然遭受打击——特朗普提名的食品药品管理局局长和美国国家科学基金会的领导人。
周二晚间，Axios 报道称，白宫突然撤回了有争议的海蒂·奥弗顿 (Heidi Overton) 领导 FDA 的提名。奥弗顿是白宫保守派国内政策的高级助手，她在疫苗、堕胎、电子烟和节育问题上的立场引起了共和党和民主党的批评和怀疑。奥弗顿反对堕胎——尽管对一些共和党人来说可能还不够强烈——并支持特朗普和肯尼迪谴责的反疫苗政策和声明，这惹恼了民主党人。
在九月的确认听证会上，奥弗顿在每个话题上都不断地阻挠参议员，甚至拒绝直接回答友好的共和党人提出的垒球问题，这让两党议员都公开感到沮丧。她回避的问题包括她将如何处理 FDA 当前对堕胎药米非司酮的安全审查，大量数据已证实米非司酮极其安全。她也不愿透露她是否同意特朗普错误地声称麻疹疫苗“相当致命”，或者给儿童注射的疫苗剂量“如汽水瓶大小”。奥弗顿一再拒绝回答特朗普是否会错。

title_en: US admits ‘substantial’ change to extradition request translation for leftist activist
title_zh: 美国承认对左翼活动人士的引渡请求翻译进行了“实质性”改变
summary: DoJ cites three examples of alterations from English into Spanish for James ‘Fergie’ Chambers after Guardian report US authorities have admitted altering the translation of an extradition request for James “Fergie” Chambers from English into Spanish, attributi
summary_zh: 在《卫报》报道美国当局承认更改后，美国司法部引用了 James ‘Fergie’ Chambers 从英语更改为西班牙语的三个例子
body_en: DoJ cites three examples of alterations from English into Spanish for James ‘Fergie’ Chambers after Guardian report

US authorities have admitted altering the translation of an extradition request for James “Fergie” Chambers from English into Spanish, attributing violent and illegal actions to the wealthy activist and philanthropist that were not in the original.

Chambers’s case is the first known instance of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money-laundering charge in the criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza.

In a notification sent to Spain’s ministry of justice, the US Department of Justice (DoJ) cites three of the examples of legally significant alterations revealed in the Guardian’s reporting on the issue, calling them “substantial [and] inadvertent”.
Trump administration accused of altering translation of request to extradite wealthy leftwing activist

The notification arrived to defense attorneys, the prosecutor and a three-judge panel on Tuesday as the judges were deliberating whether to grant the US extradition request, leading the defense team to file a motion calling for a halt in the proceedings and a new translation.

The US has now admitted to three of the alterations detailed in the Guardian’s reporting, and calls the fourth “an acceptable translation”. One of them involves introducing the word “fire” in describing late 2023 protests against Elbit, an Israeli weapons manufacturer. Two of the three charges in the criminal complaint against Chambers are related to the protests – where nothing was set on fire.
Other changes involved adding the Spanish words for “violent” and “detonate” when the original English text did not have them.

According to documents seen by the Guardian, the Trump administration notified Spain of the alterations on 12 November, the day before a hearing involving Chambers’s attorneys, the three judges and the prosecutor – but the notification only reached all parties on Tuesday.
The unusual chain of events caps off weeks of unsuccessful efforts by the defense team to get the high court to pay attention to the issue and order a new translation.

The Guardian’s reporting on the issue was based in part on a 3 November motion that Chambers’s attorneys filed with the court, identifying a dozen alterations to the original criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request.

However, the judges responded to the motion by saying “the translation offered by the requesting country’s authorities should be considered trustworthy” and that no action was required, according to Aitor Martínez, a member of Chambers’s defense team.

Then, during the hearing, the judges denied the defense team’s request to admit into evidence a 345-page report prepared by a certified Spanish translator identifying what were now 30 “incriminating changes” the US had made to a machine-made translation.

The judges also denied the attorneys’ request to present the translator as a witness in the hearing. Meanwhile, the prosecutor dismissed the issue dismissively, referring to “supposed translation errors”.

These and other prejudicial notions with specific legal implications form part of the prosecutor’s report on the case, which in turn influences the judges deciding on the extradition request, Martínez, a member of Chambers’s defense team, told the Guardian.
“I think the fact that the US recognizes what it has done shows that they were trying to fool the judges,” said Martínez. “This should touch the pride of the Spanish justice system.”

Spanish law and the extradition treaty between the US and Spain require extradition requests to be translated into Spanish by the requesting country. Martínez notes in the defense team’s motion filed on Tuesday that a 2003 extradition request from Turkey wound up being denied due to errors in translation – after defense attorneys took the case to Spain’s constitutional court, alleging violations of due process.
“We might wind up doing the same,” Martínez said.

A self-described communist and anti-imperialist, Chambers is also heir of the Cox family, owners of Atlanta-based Cox Enterprises. He sold stock back to his family worth about $250m in mid-2023 and has been funding an estimated 100 progressive and humanitarian projects in 20 countries since then.
body_zh: 在《卫报》报道后，司法部引用了 James ‘Fergie’ Chambers 从英语改为西班牙语的三个例子
美国当局承认将詹姆斯·“菲姬”·钱伯斯的引渡请求从英语翻译成西班牙语，将暴力和非法行为归咎于这位富有的活动家和慈善家，而这些行为在原文中并不存在。
钱伯斯的案件是已知的第一起美国因涉嫌支持哈马斯而寻求引渡公民的案件，这一指控显然与支持引渡请求和向帮助加沙巴勒斯坦人的组织捐款的刑事诉讼中的国际洗钱指控有关。
在发给西班牙司法部的通知中，美国司法部引用了《卫报》有关该问题的报道中披露的三个具有法律意义的重大变更的例子，称其为“重大且无意的”。
特朗普政府被指控更改引渡富有左翼活动人士请求的翻译
该通知于周二送达辩护律师、检察官和三名法官组成的小组，当时法官们正在考虑是否批准美国的引渡请求，导致辩护团队提出一项动议，要求停止诉讼程序并进行新的翻译。
美国现已承认《卫报》报道中详述的三处修改，并称第四处是“可接受的翻译”。其中之一涉及在描述 2023 年末针对以色列武器制造商埃尔比特的抗议活动时引入“火灾”一词。针对钱伯斯的刑事诉讼中的三项指控中有两项与抗议活动有关——抗议活动中没有任何东西被纵火。
其他变化包括在英文原文中没有“暴力”和“引爆”的西班牙语单词时添加这些单词。
根据《卫报》看到的文件，特朗普政府于 11 月 12 日，即钱伯斯律师、三名法官和检察官参加的听证会的前一天，向西班牙通报了这些变更，但该通知直到周二才送达各方。
这一系列不寻常的事件结束了辩护团队数周以来未能成功让高等法院关注这一问题并下令重新翻译的努力。
《卫报》对这一问题的报道部分基于钱伯斯的律师于 11 月 3 日向法院提交的动议，该动议指出了对支持引渡请求的原始刑事起诉书的十几处修改。
然而，钱伯斯辩护团队成员艾托尔·马丁内斯表示，法官对这一动议回应称，“请求国当局提供的翻译应被视为值得信赖”，并且不需要采取任何行动。
然后，在听证会上，法官驳回了辩护小组的要求，即接受由一名经过认证的西班牙语翻译编写的 345 页报告作为证据，该报告指出了美国对机器翻译所做的 30 处“有罪的修改”。
法官还驳回了律师提出的将翻译作为证人出庭的请求。与此同时，检察官轻蔑地驳回了这个问题，称其为“假定的翻译错误”。
钱伯斯辩护团队成员马丁内斯告诉《卫报》，这些和其他具有具体法律影响的偏见观念构成了检察官关于此案的报告的一部分，这反过来又影响了法官对引渡请求的决定。
“我认为美国承认自己所做的事情这一事实表明他们试图愚弄法官，”马丁内斯说。 “这应该触动西班牙司法系统的骄傲。”
西班牙法律以及美国和西班牙之间的引渡条约要求引渡请求国必须将引渡请求翻译成西班牙语。马丁内斯在辩护团队周二提交的动议中指出，2003年土耳其提出的引渡请求最终因翻译错误而被拒绝——此前辩护律师将该案提交给西班牙宪法法院，指控其违反正当程序。
“我们最终可能会做同样的事情，”马丁内斯说。
钱伯斯自称是共产主义者和反帝国主义者，也是考克斯家族的继承人，考克斯家族是亚特兰大考克斯企业的所有者。 2023 年中期，他将价值约 2.5 亿美元的股票卖回给家人，此后一直在资助 20 个国家的约 100 个进步和人道主义项目。

title_en: Mary Peltola unseats Sen. Dan Sullivan, giving Dems a 56-seat Senate majority
title_zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 击败参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan)，使民主党获得参议院 56 个席位的多数席位
summary: It's the first time in 18 years a Democrat has won a Senate race in the state.
summary_zh: 这是 18 年来民主党首次赢得该州参议员竞选。
body_en: Former Rep. Mary Peltola ousted GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska — the first time in 18 years a Democrat has won a Senate race in the state.
Her win gives Democrats a 56-44 edge in the Senate.

Peltola was one of Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s top recruits for the cycle. She overpowered a Republican rescue mission for Sullivan and allegations of misconduct against her from former staffers to flip a state President Donald Trump won by 13 points in 2024. Her victory continues the blue wave born from voters’ frustrations at high costs and the Trump administration.
Peltola will return to Washington, where she will become the first Alaska Native to serve in the Senate after previously holding the same distinction in the House.
Her campaign had projected confidence about her path to victory as the vote count dragged on in a far-flung, rural state with long grace periods for late-arriving ballots.

But her win was not without tumult. Trump’s Department of Justice sued to try to stop the certification if Sullivan lost, claiming voters could be confused by his same-name challenger. The president went so far as to call for votes for retired teacher Dan J. Sullivan and another longshot candidate in the four-way, all-party contest to be transferred to the incumbent.

The Justice Department also started probing efforts to recruit Dan J. Sullivan after a New York Times report suggesting members of Peltola’s campaign and Senate Democrats’ campaign arm were involved. Both had previously denied involvement.
body_zh: 前众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 在阿拉斯加州罢免了共和党参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan)，这是 18 年来民主党首次赢得该州参议员竞选。
她的胜利使民主党在参议院以 56 比 44 领先。
佩尔托拉是参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)在这一周期中最重要的新成员之一。她战胜了共和党对沙利文的救援任务以及前工作人员对她不当行为的指控，使唐纳德·特朗普总统在 2024 年以 13 个百分点的优势获胜。她的胜利延续了选民因高昂成本和特朗普政府的挫败感而产生的蓝色浪潮。
佩尔托拉将返回华盛顿，成为第一位在参议院任职的阿拉斯加原住民，此前她曾在众议院获得过同样的荣誉。
她的竞选团队对她的胜利之路表现出了信心，因为在一个偏远的农村州，计票工作一直在拖延，迟到的选票有很长的宽限期。
但她的胜利并非没有引起骚动。如果沙利文败诉，特朗普的司法部将提起诉讼，试图阻止该认证，声称选民可能会对他的同名挑战者感到困惑。总统甚至呼吁将四轮全党竞选中的退休教师丹·J·沙利文和另一位可能性不大的候选人的选票转移给现任总统。
在《纽约时报》的一篇报道暗示佩尔托拉的竞选团队和参议院民主党竞选部门的成员参与其中后，司法部也开始调查招募丹·J·沙利文的努力。两人此前均否认参与其中。

title_en: Bo French loses Texas country club membership
title_zh: 博·弗伦奇失去德克萨斯州乡村俱乐部会员资格
summary: The anti-immigrant Texas Republican had his membership at a historic Fort Worth country club terminated days after a bruising electoral defeat.
summary_zh: 这位反移民的德克萨斯州共和党人在选举惨败几天后，他在历史悠久的沃斯堡乡村俱乐部的会员资格被终止。
body_en: Bo French, the far-right firebrand who centered his losing campaign for the Texas Railroad Commission on his anti-immigration stance, lost his membership at a Fort Worth country club, according to a letter obtained by POLITICO .

The letter from River Crest Country Club, dated Nov. 10 and addressed to French, said the club’s board of directors voted to terminate French’s membership immediately “for reasons relating to the reputation and general welfare of the Club.”
French said Wednesday on social media that the board asked him to resign in September due to "racist posts." He said he refused to do so, leading to an expulsion meeting.
"Nothing I said in September was racist," he said in a published statement that he read to the board.

The country club, founded in 1911, is the eighth to open in the state and boasts being a “who’s who” of Fort Worth. It hosts a 6,368-yard golf course that has been a training ground for top golfers, according to its website.
River Crest declined to comment, citing its policy of not doing so about “past, present and prospective members” and club operations, its general manager said in an email.

French, who has a history of making controversial statements on immigration issues like the H-1B visa program, made headlines in September after going viral on social media for a post he made that appeared to disparage Asian American students at the University of Texas at Austin.
His remarks capitalized on the growing anti-Indian sentiment sweeping Texas and across the nation , particularly against holders of the high-skilled worker visa, a majority of whom are from India.

The post quickly drew rebukes from Democrats and some Texas Republicans, who denounced it as racist. But French stood by the post . He said he was criticizing admission and hiring policies at UT, the state’s public flagship, that he claimed discriminated against Texas residents. (State law requires a majority of admitted students at the school to be residents of the state.)

French lost by 677,000 votes in his bid to sit on the influential statewide body that regulates Texas’ oil and gas industry two months later amid a statewide wipeout for the GOP. He previously led the Tarrant County Republican Party and also had two unsuccessful state House bids.
French did not respond to requests for comment sent to multiple email addresses associated with him.
body_zh: 根据 POLITICO 获得的一封信，极右翼煽动者博·弗伦奇 (Bo French) 失去了沃斯堡乡村俱乐部的会员资格，他在德克萨斯州铁路委员会 (Texas Railroad Commission) 竞选中的失败主要集中在反移民立场上。
River Crest 乡村俱乐部于 11 月 10 日写给弗伦奇的信函称，俱乐部董事会投票决定立即终止弗伦奇的会员资格，“原因与俱乐部的声誉和整体福利有关”。
弗伦奇周三在社交媒体上表示，董事会因“种族主义帖子”而要求他在 9 月份辞职。他说他拒绝这样做，导致召开了开除会议。
“我在九月份所说的一切都不是种族主义，”他在向董事会宣读的一份已发表的声明中说道。
该乡村俱乐部成立于 1911 年，是该州开设的第八个乡村俱乐部，被誉为沃斯堡的“名人”。据其网站称，它拥有一座 6,368 码的高尔夫球场，一直是顶级高尔夫球手的训练场。
River Crest 总经理在一封电子邮件中表示，该俱乐部拒绝置评，理由是其政策不对“过去、现在和未来的会员”以及俱乐部运营发表评论。
弗兰奇曾在 H-1B 签证计划等移民问题上发表过有争议的言论，9 月份，他因发表似乎贬低德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校亚裔美国学生的帖子而在社交媒体上疯传，成为头条新闻。
他的言论利用了席卷德克萨斯州和全国各地日益高涨的反印度情绪，特别是针对持有高技能工人签证的人，其中大多数来自印度。
该帖子很快遭到民主党人和一些德克萨斯州共和党人的谴责，他们谴责这是种族主义。但弗伦奇坚守岗位。他表示，他批评该州的公立旗舰大学——德克萨斯大学的入学和招聘政策，他声称这些政策歧视德克萨斯州居民。 （州法律要求学校录取的大多数学生必须是该州居民。）
两个月后，由于共和党在全州范围内的惨败，弗伦奇在争夺德克萨斯州石油和天然气行业有影响力的全州机构席位的竞争中以 677,000 票之差落败。他此前曾领导塔兰特县共和党，并曾两次竞选州议会议员但均未成功。
弗伦奇没有回应发送到多个与他相关的电子邮件地址的置评请求。

title_en: Man charged in connection with bomb threat at Illinois ethanol plant
title_zh: 男子因伊利诺伊州乙醇工厂炸弹威胁而被指控
summary: Andrew M Kozak, 41, pleaded not guilty to two charges in federal court after an explosive device was found at facility A 41-year-old man has been charged in connection to last week’s bomb threat at an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois. On Tuesday, the justice
summary_zh: 41 岁的安德鲁·M·科扎克 (Andrew M Kozak) 在设施中发现爆炸装置后，在联邦法院对两项指控表示不认罪。一名 41 岁男子已被烧毁
body_en: Andrew M Kozak, 41, pleaded not guilty to two charges in federal court after an explosive device was found at facility
A 41-year-old man has been charged in connection to last week’s bomb threat at an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois .

On Tuesday, the justice department charged Andrew M Kozak, 41, of Chillicothe, Illinois, with one count of transmitting a threat through interstate or foreign commerce to unlawfully damage or destroy the plant using fire and an explosive, as well as one count of making threatening interstate communications.

Kozak pleaded not guilty during his first appearance in federal court on Tuesday. According to his LinkedIn page, he has been working as a process trainee at the plant since February, where he describes his role as: “Learning how to operate an ethanol plant.”
According to authorities, Kozak allegedly emailed the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in Peoria last Friday, claiming explosive devices had been placed at the facility.

The threat prompted a significant law enforcement response and forced thousands of residents in parts of Peoria and East Peoria to evacuate last Friday. A mandatory evacuation order was issued for anyone living or working within a 1-mile radius of the plant and remained in effect until last Saturday afternoon.

Authorities discovered an explosive device at the facility, which produces ethanol for fuel and alcohol, both highly flammable products. The riverfront plant spans an area roughly equivalent to 44.5 US football fields. The device did not detonate and no injuries were reported.
The Guardian has approached BioUrja Renewables for comment.

“Threats to public safety generate fear in our community and cause significant disruption to residents, who deserve to go about their days free of worry about impending violence,” Gregory M Gilmore, US attorney for the central district of Illinois, said.
“My office is committed to prosecuting these serious crimes. We are grateful to our federal and local law enforcement partners for their dedicated work in furtherance of community safety,” he added.

Christopher Amon, the ATF’s Chicago field division special agent in charge, said: “An arrest was made in this case within 72 hours, demonstrating the tireless efforts of the law enforcement and intelligence personnel who worked around the clock to investigate an act that caused mass disruption and threatened the safety of the Peoria community.”

If convicted, Kozak faces up to 10 years in prison on the first count and up to five years on the second. Each charge also carries a potential fine of up to $250,000 and up to three years of supervised release.
body_zh: 在设施内发现爆炸装置后，41 岁的安德鲁·M·科扎克 (Andrew M Kozak) 在联邦法院对两项指控表示不认罪
一名 41 岁男子因上周在伊利诺伊州皮奥里亚一家乙醇工厂发出炸弹威胁而被指控。
周二，司法部指控 41 岁的伊利诺伊州奇利科西市安德鲁·M·科扎克 (Andrew M Kozak) 罪名包括一项通过州际或对外贸易传播威胁、使用火和爆炸物非法损坏或摧毁工厂的罪名，以及一项进行州际通信威胁的罪名。
科扎克周二在联邦法院首次出庭时表示不认罪。根据他的 LinkedIn 页面，自 2 月份以来，他一直在该工厂担任工艺实习生，他将自己的角色描述为：“学习如何运营乙醇工厂。”
据当局称，科扎克上周五向位于皮奥里亚的 BioUrja Renewables 乙醇工厂发送了电子邮件，声称该工厂已放置爆炸装置。
这一威胁促使执法部门做出重大反应，并迫使皮奥里亚和东皮奥里亚部分地区的数千名居民于上周五撤离。针对工厂半径 1 英里范围内居住或工作的任何人发布了强制疏散令，该命令一直有效到上周六下午。
当局在该工厂发现了一个爆炸装置，该工厂生产燃料乙醇和酒精，这两种产品都是高度易燃的产品。河滨工厂占地约相当于 44.5 个美式足球场。该装置没有爆炸，也没有人员受伤的报告。
《卫报》已联系 BioUrja Renewables 征求意见。
伊利诺伊州中区联邦检察官格雷戈里·M·吉尔莫尔（Gregory M Gilmore）表示：“公共安全受到的威胁在我们的社区中引起恐惧，并对居民造成严重干扰，他们本应安心生活，不用担心即将发生的暴力事件。”
“我的办公室致力于起诉这些严重犯罪。我们感谢联邦和地方执法合作伙伴为促进社区安全所做的奉献工作，”他补充道。
ATF 芝加哥现场分部负责人克里斯托弗·阿蒙 (Christopher Amon) 表示：“这起案件在 72 小时内就被逮捕，这表明执法和情报人员夜以继日地调查这一造成大规模骚乱并威胁皮奥里亚社区安全的行为所做出的不懈努力。”
如果罪名成立，科扎克第一项罪名将面临最高 10 年监禁，第二项罪名将面临最高 5 年监禁。每项指控还可能面临最高 25 万美元的罚款和最长三年的监管释放。

title_en: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries as first Black House speaker despite progressives’ concerns
title_zh: 尽管进步派表示担忧，民主党还是提名哈基姆·杰弗里斯为首位黑宫议长
summary: Jeffries is set to become one of Trump’s most prominent opponents for final two years of his presidency US politics live – latest updates Democrats on Wednesday resoundingly nominated Hakeem Jeffries to serve as speaker of the House when the new Congress is sw
summary_zh: 杰弗里斯将成为特朗普总统任期最后两年最突出的反对者之一 美国政治现场——民主党的最新动态
body_en: Jeffries is set to become one of Trump’s most prominent opponents for final two years of his presidency

Democrats on Wednesday resoundingly nominated Hakeem Jeffries to serve as speaker of the House when the new Congress is sworn in next year, teeing him up to become the first Black lawmaker to lead the chamber.

A New York congressman who has served as the Democratic minority leader since 2023, Jeffries is set to become one of Donald Trump’s most prominent opponents for the final two years of his presidency, when Democrats will control both the Senate and House of Representatives and are expected to undertake aggressive efforts to check his powers.

Democrats nominated Jeffries despite concerns from some progressives that he represents a politically risky status quo for a party that is looking to capitalize on a surprisingly good performance in the midterms, where voters swept them back into power in the House and Senate with significant majorities.

The vote took place at a caucus meeting held behind closed doors, and no other lawmaker challenged Jeffries for the speakership nomination. A source familiar with the tally said Jeffries was supported by 251 of 262 ballots cast.

Following the election, Jeffries posted a photo of himself as a child on X , and wrote: “Thank you House Democrats. Together, we will deliver bold change. And make a big difference in the lives of the American people!”

The 56-year-old is set to be formally elected speaker when the House of Representatives convenes at the beginning of next year, with Democrats controlling their largest majority in nearly two decades. He would become the first Democratic House speaker since Nancy Pelosi, who will retire from Congress at the end of this year.

The caucus additionally elected the California congressman Ted Lieu to serve as their chair, the first Asian American to hold that position. Fellow Californian Pete Aguilar was named the incoming majority whip, and will be the first Latino in that role.

Jeffries, in office since 2013, served as House Democratic caucus chair during Pelosi’s second stint as speaker, from 2019 to 2023. He took over as leader when she stepped down after Democrats lost their House majority in 2022, but rankled progressives by refusing to endorse proposals to create a Medicare for All healthcare system, and for not taking a strong stance against aid to Israel amid accusations it carried out a genocide in Gaza. Earlier this month, Indivisible, a nationwide progressive organizing group, released a poll that found only 28% of registered voters view Jeffries favorably.

He has recently sought to bridge those divides, and on Tuesday announced his support for lowering the age of eligibility for Medicare, and expanding its coverage to include vision and dental treatments, and to offer it to children. He has also called for “dramatic change” in the US relationship with Israel, though in July did not vote for an amendment that would have cut military aid to the Middle Eastern ally.

The speaker of the House is one of the most powerful figures in Congress, and has the power to decide which bills come to the floor of the lower chamber. Should Jeffries win election, he will be tasked with balancing the demands of an ideologically diverse caucus composed of liberals and centrists, as well as lawmakers from safe blue districts and others from areas that Trump won handily in the 2024 vote.
The leaders of the Congressional Progressive caucus cheered Jeffries’ nomination, while noting they expected him to collaborate on passing their preferred healthcare and immigration priorities.
“CPC leadership is working daily with Leader Jeffries to make sure the Democratic majority delivers on our mandate for bold change,” its chair, Greg Casar, and his top deputies said.

“We have made significant progress since the election to lay out a progressive agenda alongside leader Jeffries, and the CPC will work with him to pass the first year of Medicare For All, an end to for-profit immigrant detention centers, and so much more.”
Some newly elected Democrats said they had opted to oppose Jeffries, because they were not convinced he would champion their priorities as speaker

Don Leonard, a newly elected Democrat representing an Ohio district Trump won two years ago, told CNN he would not vote for Jeffries unless he won commitments to end aid to Israel, and undo the supreme court’s Citizens United ruling, which allowed outside groups to spend unlimited amounts on elections.

Seven newly elected progressive Democrats – Darializa Avila Chevalier and Claire Valdez of New York, Adam Hamawy of New Jersey, Frederick Haynes of Texas, Melat Kiros of Colorado, Donavan McKinney of Michigan and Chris Rabb of Pennsylvania – announced after the vote that they had also opposed making Jeffries speaker, at least for now.

“Whether on Medicare for All, stopping ICE terror, getting money out of politics, or ending the genocide in Gaza, our constituents sent us to Congress with a mandate on these issues. We have worked to secure commitments from leader Jeffries in good-faith conversations,” the lawmakers said.

“While we have seen meaningful progress, there is still work to be done to ensure that the direction our party takes this coming Congress reflects what our constituents are demanding of leadership. Those conversations are ongoing. As such, our vote in caucus today was no.”
body_zh: 杰弗里斯将成为特朗普总统任期最后两年最突出的对手之一
民主党周三大力提名哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）在明年新国会宣誓就职时担任众议院议长，使他成为第一位领导众议院的黑人议员。
杰弗里斯是纽约国会议员，自 2023 年以来一直担任民主党少数党领袖，他将成为唐纳德·特朗普总统任期最后两年最突出的对手之一，届时民主党将控制参议院和众议院，预计将采取积极措施来制衡他的权力。
民主党提名杰弗里斯，尽管一些进步人士担心，对于一个希望利用中期选举中令人惊讶的良好表现的政党来说，杰弗里斯代表着一种政治风险的现状，选民以绝对多数将他们重新带回众议院和参议院。
投票是在一次闭门举行的核心会议上进行的，没有其他议员对杰弗里斯的议长提名提出挑战。一位熟悉统计情况的消息人士称，杰弗里斯在 262 张选票中得到了 251 票的支持。
选举结束后，杰弗里斯在 X 上发布了一张自己小时候的照片，并写道：“谢谢众议​​院民主党人。我们将共同实现大胆的变革。并为美国人民的生活带来巨大的改变！”
明年初众议院召开时，这位 56 岁的总统将正式当选为议长，民主党将控制近二十年来最大的多数席位。他将成为继南希·佩洛西之后第一位民主党众议院议长，南希·佩洛西将于今年年底从国会退休。
核心小组还选举加州国会议员刘泰德 (Ted Lieu) 担任主席，这是第一位担任该职位的亚裔美国人。加州同胞皮特·阿吉拉尔被任命为即将上任的多数党党鞭，这将是第一位担任该职位的拉丁裔人。

杰弗里斯自 2013 年起就职，在佩洛西 2019 年至 2023 年第二次担任众议院议长期间担任众议院民主党核心小组主席。杰弗里斯在民主党于 2022 年失去众议院多数席位后下台，接任众议院民主党党团主席，但他拒绝支持建立全民医疗保险制度的提案，并且在指责以色列在以色列实施种族灭绝的情况下没有对援助以色列采取强硬立场，这激怒了进步人士。加沙。本月早些时候，全国进步组织组织 Indivisible 发布了一项民意调查，发现只有 28% 的登记选民对杰弗里斯持好感。
他最近试图弥合这些分歧，并于周二宣布支持降低医疗保险资格年龄，并将其覆盖范围扩大到包括视力和牙科治疗，并向儿童提供医疗保险。他还呼吁美国与以色列的关系发生“重大改变”，尽管他在七月份没有投票支持一项削减对这个中东盟友军事援助的修正案。
众议院议长是国会中最有权势的人物之一，有权决定哪些法案提交下议院。如果杰弗里斯赢得选举，他将负责平衡由自由派和中间派以及来自安全蓝色选区和特朗普在 2024 年投票中轻松获胜地区的其他议员组成的意识形态多元化核心小组的要求。
国会进步党核心小组的领导人对杰弗里斯的提名表示欢迎，同时指出他们希望他能够合作通过他们首选的医疗保健和移民优先事项。
其主席格雷格·卡萨尔（Greg Casar）及其高级副手表示：“中国共产党领导层每天都在与领导人杰弗里斯合作，以确保民主党多数派履行我们大胆变革的使命。”
“自选举以来，我们在与领导人杰弗里斯一起制定进步议程方面取得了重大进展，中国共产党将与他合作，通过全民医疗保险第一年、结束营利性移民拘留中心等等。”
一些新当选的民主党人表示，他们选择反对杰弗里斯，因为他们不相信杰弗里斯作为议长会支持他们的优先事项
新当选的民主党人唐·伦纳德代表特朗普两年前赢得的俄亥俄州选区，他告诉美国有线电视新闻网，除非杰弗里斯赢得终止对以色列援助的承诺，并撤销最高法院的“公民联合”裁决，该裁决允许外部团体在选举上无限支出，否则他不会投票给杰弗里斯。
七名新当选的进步民主党人——纽约州的达里亚丽莎·阿维拉·谢瓦利埃和克莱尔·瓦尔迪兹、新泽西州的亚当·哈马维、德克萨斯州的弗雷德里克·海恩斯、科罗拉多州的梅拉特·基罗斯、密歇根州的多万·麦金尼和宾夕法尼亚州的克里斯·拉布——在投票后宣布，他们也反对让杰弗里斯担任议长，至少目前是这样。
“无论是全民医疗保险、制止 ICE 恐怖活动、从政治中获取资金，还是结束加沙的种族灭绝，我们的选民都将这些问题的授权委托给了我们。我们努力在真诚的对话中确保领导人杰弗里斯的承诺，”议员们表示。
“虽然我们已经看到了有意义的进展，但仍有很多工作要做，以确保我们党在本届国会采取的方向能够反映我们的选民对领导力的要求。这些对话仍在继续。因此，我们今天在核心小组中投了反对票。”

body_en: California Republicans won only four of state’s 52 US House seats in midterms | California
California Democrats flipped five seats and will send 48 representatives to DC after successful redistricting effort

California Republicans have taken an extraordinary hit in the midterm elections, with only four of the state’s 52 congressional seats going to GOP representatives, leaving the party with its smallest delegation to Washington in decades.

California Democrats flipped five seats and will be sending 48 representatives to Washington DC for the new term. The result stems from the successful redistricting effort spearheaded by the state’s Democratic governor, Gavin Newsom, as well as a seismic blue wave that has knocked out Republicans across the country in districts that previously backed Donald Trump.
The last time California Republicans held only four House seats was in 1937 when the state had just 20 total congressional representatives, according to CalMatters , a local news site.
Democrats have long been in the majority in California , the most populous state in the US, but conservative regions in the state have remained strongholds for Republican candidates.

Republicans held on to one seat in the state’s Central valley, one in northern California near the Oregon border, one east of Los Angeles and one that that includes parts of Orange county in the southern region.
Before the midterms, Republicans held eight congressional seats in California.

In the state’s central valley, progressive Democrat Randy Villegas, a community college professor, ousted a six-term Republican , David Valadao, in a redrawn district. Villegas had shunned corporate campaign donations and was endorsed by national progressive leaders, including Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Bernie Sanders.

In southern California, Democrat Marni von Wilpert beat Republican Jim Desmond, who had been endorsed by Trump, flipping a seat that was redrawn to favor Democrats . Von Wilpert, whose campaign focused on workers’ rights and affordability , will represent the state’s 48th district, previously held by Darrell Issa, a longtime Republican congressman who chose not to run for re-election after the maps were redrawn.

The final race called by the Associated Press in the state was for a Republican incumbent, Jay Obernolte, who narrowly defeated his Democratic opponent, Tessa Lynn Hodge, in a region east of LA. Obernolte won with only 50.8% of the vote despite running in a Republican-majority district.

The Democrats’ successes in the Golden state came after voters overwhelmingly supported Proposition 50 , a redistricting measure meant to counter Republicans’ partisan gerrymandering in Texas. Across the country, Republicans’ efforts to redraw districts in their favor spectacularly backfired , with the party failing to pick up nearly all the seats they redrew.
body_zh: 加州共和党在中期选举中仅赢得了该州 52 个美国众议院席位中的 4 个席位加利福尼亚州
成功重新选区后，加州民主党翻转了 5 个席位，并将向华盛顿特区派出 48 名代表
加州共和党在中期选举中遭受了非同寻常的打击，该州 52 个国会席位中只有 4 个席位属于共和党代表，这使得该党派驻华盛顿的代表团数量为数十年来最少。
加州民主党翻转了 5 个席位，并将派出 48 名代表前往华盛顿特区参加新任期。这一结果源于该州民主党州长加文·纽瑟姆(Gavin Newsom)领导的成功的选区重新划分努力，以及席卷全国的、此前支持唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)地区的共和党人掀起的蓝色浪潮。
据当地新闻网站 CalMatters 报道，加州共和党上一次仅占据 4 个众议院席位是在 1937 年，当时该州总共只有 20 名国会代表。
在美国人口最多的加州，民主党长期以来一直占据多数，但该州的保守派地区仍然是共和党候选人的大本营。
共和党保住了该州中央山谷的一个席位，一个位于加州北部靠近俄勒冈州边境的席位，一个位于洛杉矶以东的席位，以及一个包括南部地区奥兰治县部分地区的席位。
中期选举之前，共和党在加州拥有八个国会席位。
在该州的中部山谷，进步民主党社区大学教授兰迪·维勒加斯(Randy Villegas)在重新划定的选区驱逐了六届共和党人戴维·瓦拉道(David Valadao)。维勒加斯回避了企业竞选捐款，并得到了包括亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯和伯尼·桑德斯在内的国家进步领导人的支持。
在南加州，民主党人马尼·冯·威尔珀特击败了特朗普支持的共和党人吉姆·德斯蒙德，翻转了重新抽签的席位，以支持民主党。冯·威尔珀特的竞选重点是工人权利和负担能力，他将代表该州第 48 选区，该选区之前由长期担任共和党国会议员的达雷尔·伊萨 (Darrell Issa) 控制，在地图重新绘制后，达雷尔·伊萨选择不再竞选连任。
美联社在该州举行的最后一场竞选是由共和党现任议员杰伊·奥伯诺特 (Jay Obernolte) 发起，他在洛杉矶东部的一个地区以微弱优势击败了民主党对手泰莎·林恩·霍奇 (Tessa Lynn Hodge)。尽管奥伯诺尔特在共和党占多数的选区竞选，但他仅以 50.8% 的得票率获胜。
民主党在金州取得了成功，此前选民以压倒性多数支持了第 50 号提案，这是一项旨在对抗共和党在德克萨斯州的党派不公正划分选区的措施。在全国范围内，共和党重新划定对自己有利的选区的努力却适得其反，该党几乎未能获得他们重新划定的所有席位。

summary_zh: 民主党议员询问商务部长是否偏爱英伟达，以让他的成年子女和坎托·菲茨杰拉德致富 美国商务部长霍华德·卢特
body_en: Democratic lawmakers ask if commerce secretary favored Nvidia to enrich his adult children and Cantor Fitzgerald

The US commerce secretary, Howard Lutnick, faces mounting questions over his handling of the Nvidia affair as Democratic lawmakers demand answers over his family firm’s vast stake in the tech company.

Cantor Fitzgerald, the investment firm Lutnick ran for decades before joining the Trump administration , held shares in Nvidia worth “hundreds of millions of dollars” while Lutnick made key decisions affecting the tech firm’s ability to operate, according to Democrats on three key congressional committees.

“The American people deserve to know: did the secretary of commerce seriously and perhaps irreversibly compromise US national security interests to make money for his adult children and Cantor Fitzgerald?” said Jamie Raskin of Maryland, Gregory Meeks of New York and Sydney Kamlager-Dove of California.
Nvidia scandal: US treasury chief blames Lutnick’s commerce department over alleged lack of action
Cantor Fitzgerald insists it had “no role” in the Trump administration’s decisions about Nvidia.
But in a letter on Tuesday to Lutnick’s son Brandon, who now serves as chair of Cantor Fitzgerald, the trio of lawmakers demanded documents and records, including communications concerning Nvidia.

They said that they wanted to “understand whether any actions or decisions by Secretary Lutnick concerning export controls, enforcement measures, or national security policies may have been improperly influenced by Cantor Fitzgerald’s holdings or business interests”.

Raskin is the top Democrat on the judiciary committee of the House of Representatives . Meeks is the top Democrat on the foreign affairs committee. Kamlager-Dove is the top Democrat on the foreign affairs subcommittee on south and central Asia.

In an accompanying news release , the lawmakers said that they were seeking to determine whether Lutnick “blocked efforts to stop the suspected smuggling of advanced Nvidia chips to China while his family’s firm held hundreds of millions of dollars in Nvidia stock”.
Howard Lutnick led Cantor Fitzgerald until his confirmation as commerce secretary in February 2025, when he transferred his stake in the firm to trusts benefiting his adult children .

In the letter to Brandon Lutnick, the lawmakers wrote that at the time of Howard Lutnick’s confirmation, Cantor Fitzgerald had “amassed a significant stake” in Nvidia , reportedly “holding more than 3.5m shares, valued at over $1.3bn”.

In a statement to the Guardian, a Cantor Fitzgerald spokesperson said that the claims in the letter were “inaccurate”. “Cantor holds no material proprietary position in Nvidia,” the spokesperson said. “Cantor’s Nvidia holdings arise primarily from equity swaps executed for clients.

“The decline in our holdings since early 2025 reflects the unwinding of those hedges as clients closed or reduced their swap positions, not a Cantor decision to exit a proprietary position,” the statement continued. “Allegations suggesting that work influenced government decisions are baseless. Additionally, Cantor has no role in US export control or entity list decisions [to determine trade restrictions].”

The Cantor Fitzgerald spokesperson also said that they were “confident that a full review of the facts will demonstrate that we have operated our business ethically and in full compliance with all applicable rules and regulations”.

In their letter, the lawmakers also cited a recent New York Times report that Howard Lutnick had pushed to weaken rules affecting south-east Asian datacenters, some of which are Cantor Fitzgerald clients.

A commerce department spokesperson told the Times that Lutnick makes policy decisions based on the best interests of the US and that he does not discuss department matters with his sons. The spokesperson added that Lutnick’s sons also do not discuss Cantor Fitzgerald business with him.

In their letter on Tuesday, the lawmakers asked Cantor Fitzgerald to provide written confirmation that it had “implemented appropriate preservation measures and instructed all relevant personnel to retain potentially responsive records” by 5pm ET on 1 December.
The letter comes after Jensen Huang resigned from Nvidia last week, following reports of his multiple affairs, including one with Alice Huang, who is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
body_zh: 民主党议员询问商务部长是否支持英伟达来丰富他的成年子女和坎托·菲茨杰拉德
美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 在处理英伟达事件方面面临越来越多的质疑，民主党议员要求就其家族公司在这家科技公司持有的巨额股份做出答复。
据国会三个主要委员会的民主党人称，卢特尼克在加入特朗普政府之前经营了数十年的投资公司坎托·菲茨杰拉德(Cantor Fitzgerald)持有价值“数亿美元”的英伟达股票，而卢特尼克则做出了影响这家科技公司运营能力的关键决策。
“美国人民应该知道：商务部长是否严重且可能不可逆转地损害了美国的国家安全利益，以便为他的成年子女和坎托·菲茨杰拉德赚钱？”马里兰州的杰米·拉斯金（Jamie Raskin）、纽约州的格雷戈里·米克斯（Gregory Meeks）和加利福尼亚州的悉尼·卡姆拉格·多夫（Sydney Kamlager-Dove）说道。
英伟达丑闻：美国财政部长指责卢特尼克商务部缺乏行动
坎托·菲茨杰拉德坚称，它在特朗普政府对英伟达的决定中“没有任何作用”。
但在周二写给卢特尼克的儿子布兰登（现任坎托·菲茨杰拉德公司主席）的一封信中，三名议员要求提供文件和记录，包括有关英伟达的通信内容。
他们表示，他们希望“了解卢特尼克部长有关出口管制、执法措施或国家安全政策的任何行动或决定是否可能受到坎托·菲茨杰拉德的持股或商业利益的不当影响”。
拉斯金是众议院司法委员会的最高民主党人。米克斯是外交事务委员会的最高民主党人。卡姆拉格-多夫是南亚和中亚外交事务小组委员会的最高民主党人。
在随附的新闻稿中，议员们表示，他们正在寻求确定卢特尼克是否“阻止了阻止涉嫌走私先进英伟达芯片到中国的努力，而他的家族公司持有价值数亿美元的英伟达股票”。
霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 领导坎托·菲茨杰拉德 (Cantor Fitzgerald)，直至 2025 年 2 月确认担任商务部长，当时他将公司股份转让给了受益于其成年子女的信托基金。
在给布兰登·卢特尼克的信中，议员们写道，在霍华德·卢特尼克得到确认时，坎托·菲茨杰拉德已经“积累了大量股份”，据报道“持有超过 350 万股，价值超过 13 亿美元”。
坎托·菲茨杰拉德发言人在给《卫报》的一份声明中表示，信中的说法“不准确”。该发言人表示：“坎托在英伟达不拥有任何实质性专有地位。” “坎托持有的英伟达股份主要来自为客户执行的股权互换。
声明继续说道：“自 2025 年初以来，我们持仓量的下降反映了随着客户平仓或减少掉期头寸而解除这些对冲，而不是 Cantor 决定退出自营头寸。” “有关工作影响政府决策的指控毫无根据。此外，坎托在美国出口管制或实体清单决策（以确定贸易限制）中没有任何作用。”
坎托·菲茨杰拉德的发言人还表示，他们“相信对事实的全面审查将证明我们以道德方式经营我们的业务，并完全遵守所有适用的规则和法规”。
议员们在信中还引用了《纽约时报》最近的一篇报道，称霍华德·卢特尼克推动削弱了影响东南亚数据中心的规则，其中一些数据中心是坎托·菲茨杰拉德的客户。
商务部发言人告诉《泰晤士报》，卢特尼克是根据美国的最大利益做出政策决定的，他不会与儿子们讨论商务部事务。该发言人补充说，卢特尼克的儿子们也不与他讨论坎托·菲茨杰拉德的生意。
在周二的信中，议员们要求坎托·菲茨杰拉德 (Cantor Fitzgerald) 在 12 月 1 日美国东部时间下午 5 点之前提供书面确认，证明其已“实施了适当的保存措施，并指示所有相关人员保留可能敏感的记录”。
这封信是在黄仁勋上周从英伟达辞职后发出的，此前有报道称他有多项婚外情，其中包括与涉嫌中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)的婚外情。

title_en: Cornyn links Nvidia scandal to perception of Trump admin corruption
title_zh: 科宁将英伟达丑闻与特朗普政府腐败的看法联系起来
summary: The outgoing Texas Republican senator said “the buck stops with [Trump]” when pressed on whether the White House plays a role in the appearance of corruption and self-dealing.
summary_zh: 当被问及白宫是否在特朗普的出现中发挥作用时，这位即将离任的德克萨斯州共和党参议员表示，“责任归特朗普所有”。
body_en: Outgoing Sen. John Cornyn sees the Nvidia scandal and questions about the Trump administration’s alleged lax chip export control rules as part of a broader perception of corruption, which he said contributed to the Republican drubbing in the midterms.

“Let’s talk about Nvidia and export controls,” the Texas Republican said when asked to name examples of corruption he sees at the federal level during an onstage interview at the Atlantic Summit on Tuesday.

He then pointed to media reports that advanced Nvidia chips may have been diverted to China through the Singapore-based company Megaspeed, and that the Commerce Department, led by Secretary Howard Lutnick, resisted efforts by other Cabinet agencies to crack down on Megaspeed.

“I just think there’s a lot of things that will be investigated, and we’ll learn more about, basically, this perception that there was self-dealing going on that I think caused a lot of unease by the American people,” Cornyn said.

He said President Donald Trump is at the center of the perceived corruption — “the buck stops with him” — and that many congressional Republicans, fearing the White House’s retribution, have chosen not to cross the president publicly.

Cornyn’s remarks come as fallout from the Nvidia turmoil that led to CEO Jensen Huang’s ouster continues to roil Washington. The Trump administration is scrambling to further restrict China’s access to the most advanced American chips as pressure mounts from Capitol Hill, which is also set to hear testimony from Huang and Lutnick in the coming weeks.

The four-term senator, who lost his primary earlier this year to the Trump-endorsed Ken Paxton, did not mince words when asked about the cause of the blue wave that swept even statewide offices across his home state. “Well, President Trump said he was on the ballot.”

In a pair of statements, White House spokespeople blamed Democrats for refusing “to do anything to stop waste, fraud, and abuse in our government” and highlighted the Commerce Department’s interim final rule to “crack down on the smuggling of advanced U.S. SI chips, including through third countries and remote access by Chinese SI labs.”

“The Trump Administration will continue to take decisive action to protect America’s technological edge, strengthen our national security, and ensure the future of SI is built in America,” White House spokesperson Matthew Middleton said.
Cornyn in his remarks Tuesday also urged Washington to keep China as its top national security and foreign policy focus, as Trump is set to meet with China’s leader Xi Jinping later this week.

He warned about disruption to the semiconductor supply chain should China try to invade Taiwan, its island democracy neighbor that produces an overwhelming majority of the world’s most advanced chips.

“The idea that there could be another pandemic or military conflict or natural disaster that would disrupt that ought to worry everybody,” he said. “That’s one of my principal concerns is what China may or may not do in the Taiwan Straits.”
body_zh: 即将离任的参议员约翰·科宁 (John Cornyn) 将英伟达丑闻和有关特朗普政府所谓宽松的芯片出口管制规则的问题视为更广泛的腐败认知的一部分，他表示，这导致了共和党在中期选举中惨败。
“让我们来谈谈英伟达和出口管制，”这位得克萨斯州共和党人在周二大西洋峰会的台上采访中被问及他在联邦层面看到的腐败例子时说道。
随后，他指出媒体报道称，先进的英伟达芯片可能已通过新加坡公司 Megaspeed 转移到中国，而由部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 领导的商务部抵制了其他内阁机构打击 Megaspeed 的努力。
科宁说：“我只是认为有很多事情需要调查，我们基本上会更多地了解这种认为存在自我交易行为的看法，我认为这引起了美国人民的很多不安。”
他说，唐纳德·特朗普总统是腐败的中心——“责任归他所有”——许多国会共和党人担心白宫的报复，选择不公开反对总统。
科宁发表上述言论之际，英伟达公司的混乱导致首席执行官黄仁勋被罢免，其余波继续扰乱华盛顿。随着来自国会山的压力越来越大，特朗普政府正在争先恐后地进一步限制中国获得最先进的美国芯片，国会山也将在未来几周内听取黄仁勋和卢特尼克的证词。
这位四届参议员今年早些时候在初选中输给了特朗普支持的肯·帕克斯顿(Ken Paxton)，当被问及席卷他家乡甚至全州办公室的蓝色浪潮的原因时，他毫不拐弯抹角。 “嗯，特朗普总统说他参加了投票。”
在两份声明中，白宫发言人指责民主党拒绝“采取任何措施制止我国政府的浪费、欺诈和滥用行为”，并强调了商务部的临时最终规则，即“打击走私美国先进的 SI 芯片，包括通过第三国和中国 SI 实验室的远程访问。”
白宫发言人马修·米德尔顿表示：“特朗普政府将继续采取果断行动，保护美国的技术优势，加强我们的国家安全，并确保 SI 的未来建立在美国。”
科宁在周二的讲话中还敦促华盛顿继续将中国作为其国家安全和外交政策的最高焦点，因为特朗普将于本周晚些时候会见中国领导人习近平。
他警告说，如果中国试图入侵台湾，半导体供应链将受到破坏。台湾是台湾的岛国民主邻国，世界上绝大多数最先进的芯片都由台湾生产。
他说：“可能会出现另一场流行病、军事冲突或自然灾害，从而扰乱这一局面，这一想法应该让所有人感到担忧。” “我主要担心的问题之一是中国在台湾海峡可能会做什么或不会做什么。”

title_en: Musk says he's "not MAGA," feels "foolish" about midterm spending
title_zh: 马斯克称他“不是MAGA”，对中期支出感到“愚蠢”
summary: After opening his wallet to assist GOP candidates in the 2026 midterms, billionaire Elon Musk said Wednesday he feels "pretty foolish" about spending hundreds of millions of dollars in the race.
summary_zh: 亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)在掏出钱包帮助2026年中期选举的共和党候选人后周三表示，他对花钱感到“非常愚蠢”
body_en: Elon Musk says he's "not MAGA," feels "foolish" about how much he spent in midterms - CBS News
After opening his wallet to assist GOP candidates in the 2026 midterms, billionaire Elon Musk said Wednesday he feels "pretty foolish" about spending hundreds of millions of dollars.

The world's richest man — who served in President Trump's administration in 2025 — also argued he is "not MAGA" and described his political beliefs as "quite moderate" during an interview at The New York Times' DealBook Summit.

Musk donated vast sums of money to super PACs backing House and Senate Republicans. One of his largest investments was in Texas, where over $150 million of his fortune was transferred to a group supporting Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton.

Those bets largely did not pay off. Democrats won large majorities in the House and Senate, with Paxton losing to Democratic candidate James Talarico, who made Musk's support of his GOP opponent part of his pitch to voters. Democrats also won the Texas governor's office, a notable shift for the state where Musk has based many of SpaceX and Tesla's operations.

Musk told interviewer Andrew Ross Sorkin his objective in the midterms was to help Republicans hold on to their Senate majority in 2029 in order to prevent either party from controlling the presidency and both houses of Congress in 2029 — a goal he said "failed."

"Obviously, the Republicans were routed in this election, and … I feel pretty foolish about having spent so much money and not seeing much for it. Or maybe it would have been much worse without that," the billionaire said, adding that "probably if I could rewind the clock, I would have spent less money."
Musk later said his goal was to preserve some "checks and balances," calling himself "ideologically quite moderate" and saying he doesn't have any "extreme political views."
Sorkin noted that Musk has made controversial statements on immigration and "MAGA stuff."

Musk responded: "I'm not MAGA. … I'm not sure what MAGA means, but I don't think I'm, like, if it means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that. I think there are positives and negatives in both parties."

It's a change in tone for Musk, who joked in one 2024 Trump rally: "I'm not just MAGA, I'm dark MAGA." Musk spent hundreds of millions of dollars assisting the Trump campaign and other GOP candidates that year, and later led the Trump administration's cost-cutting Department of Government Efficiency. Musk and Mr. Trump had a brief falling-out last year , but Musk has appeared to maintain a close relationship with the president since then.
Musk traveled to China this week for Mr. Trump's trip to the country.

Musk's alliance with Mr. Trump has drawn scrutiny from Democrats, who have vowed to aggressively investigate the Trump administration when they take the House and Senate next year. Musk is expected to be one focus of their oversight probes.

In Wednesday's interview, Musk said he is not worried that Democratic Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa could pose problems to his businesses, saying, "Based on everything I've heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor."
"The new governor, actually, I think, is going to be quite moderate," Musk said. "I don't think she's sort of a far-left governor."
He also said some Democrats' comments accusing him of illegality are "a little over the top," telling the Times, "There are definitely a few people grumpy about ... my funding in this past election."
"Hopefully in this country, you still need to do an actual crime before you go to prison. Aspirationally, that should be how it works," he said.

body_zh: 埃隆·马斯克说他“不是 MAGA”，对自己在中期选举中花了多少钱感到“愚蠢” - 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻
亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)在掏出钱包支持2026年中期选举的共和党候选人后，周三表示，他觉得花费数亿美元“非常愚蠢”。
这位曾于 2025 年在特朗普总统政府任职的世界首富在接受《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会采访时也表示，自己“不是 MAGA”，并称自己的政治信仰“相当温和”。
马斯克向支持众议院和参议院共和党人的超级政治行动委员会捐赠了大量资金。他最大的投资之一是在德克萨斯州，他将超过 1.5 亿美元的财富转移给了一个支持共和党参议院候选人肯·帕克斯顿的团体。
这些赌注基本上没有得到回报。民主党在众议院和参议院赢得了多数席位，帕克斯顿输给了民主党候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科，后者让马斯克对共和党对手的支持成为他向选民宣传的一部分。民主党还赢得了德克萨斯州州长的职位，这对于马斯克在该州开展的 SpaceX 和特斯拉的许多业务来说是一个显着的转变。
马斯克告诉采访者安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金（Andrew Ross Sorkin），他中期选举的目标是帮助共和党在 2029 年保住参议院多数席位，以防止任何一方在 2029 年控制总统职位和国会两院——他说这个目标“失败了”。
这位亿万富翁说：“显然，共和党在这次选举中惨败，而且……我觉得自己花了这么多钱却没有看到太多好处，这非常愚蠢。或者如果没有这一点，情况可能会更糟。”他补充说，“也许如果我能让时间倒转，我会花更少的钱。”
马斯克后来表示，他的目标是保留一些“制衡”，称自己“在意识形态上相当温和”，并表示自己没有任何“极端政治观点”。
索尔金指出，马斯克在移民和“MAGA 的事情”方面发表了有争议的言论。
马斯克回应道：“我不是 MAGA。……我不确定 MAGA 是什么意思，但我不认为，如果这意味着盲目遵守共和党的一系列政策，那么我当然不这么认为。我认为两党都有积极和消极的一面。”
对于马斯克来说，这是语气的转变，他在 2024 年的一次特朗普集会上开玩笑说：“我不仅仅是 MAGA，我还是黑暗的 MAGA。”马斯克当年花费数亿美元协助特朗普竞选和其他共和党候选人，后来领导了特朗普政府削减成本的政府效率部。去年，马斯克和特朗普发生了短暂的争吵，但自那以后，马斯克似乎一直与总统保持着密切的关系。
马斯克本周前往中国参加特朗普的中国之行。
马斯克与特朗普的联盟引起了民主党人的密切关注，他们誓言明年入主众议院和参议院时将积极调查特朗普政府。预计马斯克将成为他们监督调查的焦点之一。
在周三的采访中，马斯克表示，他并不担心当选的民主党德克萨斯州州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨会给他的企业带来问题，他说：“根据我所听到的有关她的一切，我认为吉娜担任州长后，德克萨斯州的一切都会好起来的。”
“实际上，我认为新州长将会相当温和，”马斯克说。 “我不认为她是一位极左州长。”
他还表示，一些民主党人指责他非法的言论“有点过分”，他告诉《泰晤士报》，“肯定有一些人对我在上次选举中的资助感到不满。”
“希望在这个国家，你在入狱之前仍然需要犯下实际的罪行。理想情况下，这应该是它的运作方式，”他说。

title_en: Hakeem Jeffries faces test to becoming House speaker during leadership elections
title_zh: 哈基姆·杰弗里斯在领导人选举中面临成为众议院议长的考验
summary: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries faces a crucial test on his way to becoming the nation’s first Black speaker of the House as Democrats meet privately to elect their leadership for the new Congress and nominate him for the job
summary_zh: 民主党人哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）在成为美国第一位黑人众议院议长的道路上面临着关键考验，因为民主党人私下会面选举
body_en: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries faces a crucial test on his way to becoming the nation’s first Black speaker of the House as Democrats meet privately to elect their leadership for the new Congress and nominate him for the job
By LISA MASCARO AP congressional correspondent

WASHINGTON -- Democrat Hakeem Jeffries will face a crucial test Wednesday on his way to becoming the nation's first Black speaker of the House when Democrats meet privately to elect their leadership for the new Congress and nominate him for the job.

Jeffries is running unopposed but faces a restive party eager for a change after voters ousted Republicans in a rebuke of President Donald Trump and the party in power. Phone calls and social media posts have been flooding the offices of Democrats and the newly elected, demanding a fresh start. Protesters heckled Jeffries last week during a Democratic conference in Denver.

Ahead of Wednesday's closed-door voting, Jeffries, of New York, said he takes nothing for granted. He was meeting with the caucuses that make up the House Democrats and talking to almost all members in what will be their large majority. He is seeking a recorded vote so Democrats can make their views known.

He is part of a leadership trio with Rep. Katherine Clark of Massachusetts and Rep. Pete Aguilar of California, who would all be historic firsts — Clark as the first female majority leader and Aguilar as the first Latino to serve as the majority whip. They also ran unopposed.
Jeffries would face a separate roll call of the whole House to become speaker when the new Congress convenes on Jan. 3, 2027.

Wednesday’s vote will be the first of their careers for dozens of members-elect , before they’re even sworn into office in January. With one of the biggest incoming majorities in decades, Jeffries will have room to spare.

Rep.-elect Brad Lander of New York announced he would support Jeffries when he launched his campaign for Congress. Rep.-elect Randy Villegas of California has said he was supporting whoever would help him best deliver for his Central Valley district.

Returning Rep. Emily Randall of Washington said she heard questions about House leadership during town halls in her district and has been watching direct messages stream into her Instagram feed about the leadership election. So she decided to start dialing them back.

“People have messaged me asking if Bernie Sanders could be the speaker of the House,” she said, referring to the Vermont independent senator who caucuses with Democrats. “Technically yes, and it would be probably difficult.”
(It's true that the House can elect anyone speaker, but it's unlikely to be Sanders because he already has his day job in the Senate.)

On one call, Randall said, she listened to the constituent's concerns and then replied, “Truthfully, not like blowing smoke, whoever is our speaker — and I think it is going to be Hakeem Jeffries, and I am supporting Hakeem Jeffries for speaker — I think we will accomplish a lot of the things that he was asking us to.”

Lawmakers pointed to the livestream that Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New York did trying to explain the role of the speaker.
“There is one candidate in this race: Hakeem Jeffries,” Ocasio-Cortez said at the Capitol. “I think that everyone is far more concerned what that leadership means, what is it promising.”
Jeffries, Clark and Aguilar have risen together, as a team, as the first new generation of leaders of the post-Pelosi era and will soon serve as leaders in the majority for the first time.
body_zh: 民主党人哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）在成为美国第一位黑人众议院议长的道路上面临着至关重要的考验，因为民主党人私下开会选举新一届国会的领导层并提名他担任这一职务
美联社国会记者 LISA MASCARO
华盛顿——民主党人哈基姆·杰弗里斯周三将在成为美国第一位黑人众议院议长的道路上面临关键考验，届时民主党将举行私下会议，选举新一届国会的领导层并提名他担任这一职务。
杰弗里斯在竞选中没有遇到反对者，但在选民谴责唐纳德·特朗普总统和执政党并驱逐共和党人后，他面临着一个渴望变革的不安定政党。民主党人和新当选者的办公室里充斥着电话和社交媒体帖子，要求重新开始。上周在丹佛举行的民主党会议上，抗议者质问杰弗里斯。
在周三的闭门投票之前，纽约的杰弗里斯表示，他不认为任何事情都是理所当然的。他正在与组成众议院民主党的核心小组会面，并与几乎所有成员进行了交谈，这将是他们的绝大多数成员。他正在寻求记录投票，以便民主党人能够表达他们的观点。
他是马萨诸塞州众议员凯瑟琳·克拉克（Katherine Clark）和加利福尼亚州众议员皮特·阿吉拉尔（Pete Aguilar）组成的领导三人组的一员，这三人都将创造历史性的第一——克拉克是第一位女性多数党领袖，阿吉拉尔是第一位担任多数党党鞭的拉丁裔。他们也没有遇到反对。
当新一届国会于 2027 年 1 月 3 日召开时，杰弗里斯将面临众议院单独的唱名表决，以担任议长。
周三的投票将是数十名当选议员职业生涯中的第一次投票，他们甚至在 2027 年 1 月 3 日新一届国会召开时宣誓就职。如果杰弗里斯再次当选民主党领袖，他将在一月份面临众议院全体议员的单独点名，以成为议长。
纽约当选众议员布拉德·兰德在杰弗里斯发起国会竞选活动时宣布他将支持杰弗里斯。加利福尼亚州当选众议员兰迪·维勒加斯 (Randy Villegas) 表示，他支持任何能帮助他最好地为中央谷区做出贡献的人。
华盛顿州众议员艾米丽·兰德尔 (Emily Randall) 表示，她在所在选区的市政厅听到了有关众议院领导层的问题，并一直在关注她的 Instagram 上关于领导层选举的直接信息流。所以她决定开始回拨他们。
她说：“人们给我发信息询问伯尼·桑德斯是否可以担任众议院议长。”她指的是与民主党一起参加党团会议的佛蒙特州独立参议员。 “从技术上讲是可以的，但这可能会很困难。”
（确实，众议院可以选举任何人为议长，但不太可能是桑德斯，因为他已经在参议院担任日常工作。）
兰德尔说，在一次电话会议上，她听取了选民的担忧，然后回答说：“说实话，无论谁是我们的发言人，都不像吹烟一样——我认为这将是哈基姆·杰弗里斯，我支持哈基姆·杰弗里斯担任发言人——我认为我们将完成他要求我们做的很多事情。”

title_en: Sen. Elissa Slotkin fires back at DOJ official over investigation of her political speech
title_zh: 参议员埃丽莎·斯洛特金 (Elissa Slotkin) 就其政治演讲调查向司法部官员进行回击
summary: U.S. Attorney Aaron Reitz has suggested that Slotkin’s comments about congressional oversight could amount to a criminal civil rights offense.
summary_zh: 美国检察官亚伦·雷茨表示，斯洛特金有关国会监督的言论可能构成刑事民权犯罪。
body_en: Elissa Slotkin fires back at DOJ official over investigation of her political speech

WASHINGTON — A Democratic senator repeatedly targeted by the Trump administration for potential prosecution due to her political remarks is firing back at a Trump-appointed Justice Department official over what she called a “baseless” inquiry into her rhetoric about congressional oversight.

Sen. Elissa Slotkin, D-Mich., is one of five Democratic members of Congress who have been the subject of letters that U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Texas Aaron Reitz has posted on social media. In one of the letters, which have come under scrutiny from legal experts, Reitz suggested that Slotkin’s comments about congressional oversight potentially acting as a “deterrence message” to people considering joining the Trump administration could amount to a criminal civil rights offense.

“I made those statements consistent with my basic right to freedom of speech, a right that every American enjoys under the First Amendment to the U.S. Constitution,” Slotkin wrote Wednesday in a letter to Reitz obtained by NBC News. “In addition to my First Amendment rights, as a United States Senator, oversight is an important constitutional responsibility.”

“The Constitution’s Speech or Debate clause bars prosecution of a legislator for conducting an investigation or performing other legislative acts,” she wrote. “As such, your threat of investigation is baseless, and you should withdraw your letter immediately.”

Slotkin went on to say that Reitz’s “public threats” violated Justice Department policy, and that his decision to publicly post the letter rather than providing it to her, her attorney, or Senate legal counsel “is evidence that your threat of investigation is more about publicity and your political ambitions than any sort of legitimate inquiry.”

Reitz, 39, previously worked as chief of staff for Sen. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, and became U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Texas over the summer after placing fourth in the Republican primary for Texas attorney general.
Reitz also posted letters on X to Sen. Elizabeth Warren , D-Mass.; Sen. Richard Blumenthal , D-Conn.; Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif.,; and Sen. Adam Schiff , D-Calif.
He told NBC News this week that he was “not interested in chilling free speech.”

Slotkin and five other sitting Democratic lawmakers were separately targeted by the Trump administration earlier this year over a video they posted to social media that sought to remind members of the military and intelligence communities that they should not obey unlawful orders. Allies of U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro tried to indict the six Democrats for their speech in that video, but federal grand jurors unanimously rejected the indictment attempt.

Slotkin’s attorney, Prett Bharara, had previously written a letter to Attorney General Todd Blanche cautioning him against following President Donald Trump’s public instruction to look into Slotkin’s political speech, which he dubbed a “criminal act.”

Blanche has conceded that Slotkin’s words alone were “absolutely not a crime” and said at a press conference last week that there were “no ongoing investigations, criminal investigations, into words that incoming senators or congressmen have said.”
Slotkin wrote in her letter that Reitz appeared to be “seeking attention” for himself and the Justice Department, or was “unaware” of basic constitutional rights.

“Given all of this, your threats are frivolous and a violation of your ethical duties as an attorney,” she wrote. “I reserve all rights to take appropriate actions in the future as it relates to this sham investigation.”
Ryan J. Reilly is a justice reporter for NBC News.
body_zh: 埃丽莎·斯洛特金 (Elissa Slotkin) 就其政治演讲调查向司法部官员进行回击
华盛顿——一名民主党参议员因其政治言论而多次成为特朗普政府可能起诉的目标，她对特朗普任命的司法部官员进行了回击，称对她有关国会监督的言论进行了“毫无根据”的调查。
密歇根州民主党参议员埃丽莎·斯洛特金 (Elissa Slotkin) 是德克萨斯州南区联邦检察官亚伦·雷茨 (Aaron Reitz) 在社交媒体上发布的信件主题的五名民主党国会议员之一。在其中一封受到法律专家审查的信件中，赖茨表示，斯洛特金关于国会监督的评论可能对考虑加入特朗普政府的人构成“威慑信息”，可能构成刑事民权犯罪。
斯洛特金周三在 NBC 新闻获得的一封写给赖茨的信中写道：“我的这些声明符合我的言论自由基本权利，这是每个美国人根据美国宪法第一修正案享有的权利。” “除了我的第一修正案权利之外，作为一名美国参议员，监督也是一项重要的宪法责任。”
“宪法的演讲或辩论条款禁止起诉进行调查或执行其他立法行为的立法者，”她写道。 “因此，你的调查威胁毫无根据，你应该立即撤回你的信。”
斯洛特金接着表示，雷茨的“公开威胁”违反了司法部的政策，他决定公开发布这封信，而不是将其提供给她、她的律师或参议院法律顾问，“证明你的调查威胁更多的是出于宣传和政治野心，而不是任何形式的合法调查。”
雷茨现年 39 岁，此前曾担任德克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹 (Ted Cruz) 的幕僚长，并在共和党德克萨斯州总检察长初选中获得第四名，并于今年夏天成为德克萨斯州南区联邦检察官。
赖茨还在 X 上发表了致马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 的信件；康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (Richard Blumenthal)；加利福尼亚州民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚；和加利福尼亚州民主党参议员亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff)。
他本周告诉 NBC 新闻，他“对压制言论自由不感兴趣”。
今年早些时候，斯洛特金和其他五名现任民主党议员因在社交媒体上发布的一段视频而分别成为特朗普政府的目标，该视频试图提醒军方和情报界成员不应服从非法命令。美国哥伦比亚特区检察官珍妮·皮罗 (Jeanine Pirro) 的盟友试图起诉六名民主党人在该视频中的演讲，但联邦大陪审团一致拒绝了起诉企图。
斯洛特金的律师普雷特·巴拉拉此前曾写信给司法部长托德·布兰奇，警告他不要听从唐纳德·特朗普总统的公开指示，调查斯洛特金的政治演讲，他称之为“犯罪行为”。
布兰奇承认，斯洛特金的话“绝对不是犯罪”，并在上周的新闻发布会上表示，“没有对即将上任的参议员或国会议员所说的话进行任何正在进行的调查、刑事调查。”
斯洛特金在信中写道，赖茨似乎是在为自己和司法部“寻求关注”，或者“不知道”基本的宪法权利。
“考虑到这一切，你的威胁是毫无意义的，而且违反了你作为律师的道德义务，”她写道。 “我保留未来针对这次虚假调查采取适当行动的所有权利。”
瑞安·J·赖利 (Ryan J. Reilly) 是 NBC 新闻的司法记者。

title_en: Girlfriend of American killed in Costa Rica arrested
title_zh: 哥斯达黎加遇害美国人女友被捕
summary: The former girlfriend of Kurt Van Dyke, who comes from a legendary surfing family, has been arrested, along with another man, on suspicion of murder.
summary_zh: 来自传奇冲浪世家的科特·范戴克的前女友因涉嫌谋杀而与另一名男子一起被捕。
body_en: Brother of American killed in Costa Rica says he's focused on justice after arrest of former girlfriend - CBS News
American surfer and businessman Kurt Van Dyke was found stabbed and strangled in his Costa Rica home earlier this year. Now, his girlfriend and another man are in custody on suspicion of murder.

Heavily armed Costa Rican police arrested the two in the dark of night last week, some nine months after the 66-year-old was found dead in the town of Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, where he owned a hotel. His 31-year-old girlfriend, whom police have only identified by her last name, Arroyo, survived the attack without any serious injuries, police said initially.

The other person arrested was identified as a 34-year-old man with the last name Gutiérrez. Police allege he and Arroyo "planned a robbery targeting the American with the intent of obtaining the PINs for bank cards" linked to the hotel.
Van Dyke's brother, Peter Van Dyke, told CBS News the revelation that police suspect she was involved in Kurt Van Dyke's death is "shocking."
He said the fact that she was found alive following the attack struck him and his family as "extremely odd," but said he "didn't want to make any speculations."
Kurt Van Dyke had lived in Costa Rica since the '80s. He comes from a legendary surfing family that pioneered the sport in Santa Cruz, California.
Now that arrests have been made, Peter Van Dyke says the focus is on justice.

"I can't say the word 'happy' because this is not a happy situation," he told CBS News. "We're just satisfied with the outcome so far. I have faith in the Costa Rican law enforcement. It took them nine months, and I totally understand why."
Kurt Van Dyke had three children, and his family said his eldest son plans to be in Costa Rica for the eventual murder trial.

body_zh: 在哥斯达黎加被杀的美国人兄弟表示前女友被捕后他专注于正义 - 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻
今年早些时候，美国冲浪运动员兼商人库尔特·范戴克被发现在哥斯达黎加的家中被刺伤并被勒死。现在，他的女友和另一名男子因涉嫌谋杀而被拘留。
上周，全副武装的哥斯达黎加警方在深夜逮捕了两人，大约九个月前，这名 66 岁的男子被发现死在塔拉曼卡旧港镇，他在那里拥有一家酒店。警方最初表示，他 31 岁的女友在袭击中幸存下来，没有受到任何严重伤害。警方仅透露了她的姓氏阿罗约。
另一名被捕者是一名 34 岁男子，姓古铁雷斯 (Gutiérrez)。警方称，他和阿罗约“策划了针对这名美国人的抢劫，目的是获取与酒店相关的银行卡密码”。
范戴克的兄弟彼得·范戴克告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，警方怀疑她参与库尔特·范戴克之死的消息“令人震惊”。
他说，袭击发生后她被发现还活着，这让他和他的家人感到“非常奇怪”，但他“不想做出任何猜测”。
库尔特·范·戴克 (Kurt Van Dyke) 自 80 年代以来一直居住在哥斯达黎加。他来自加利福尼亚州圣克鲁斯一个传奇的冲浪世家，是这项运动的先驱。
彼得·范·戴克表示，既然逮捕工作已经完成，那么重点就是伸张正义。
“我不能说‘快乐’这个词，因为这不是一个快乐的情况，”他告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻。 “到目前为止，我们对结果感到满意。我对哥斯达黎加执法部门有信心。他们花了九个月的时间，我完全理解为什么。”
库尔特·范戴克有三个孩子，他的家人表示，他的大儿子计划前往哥斯达黎加接受最终的谋杀案审判。
